item.title: President Lee: “Excess Profit Debates Over Samsung Electronics Must Be Handled with Caution… We Must Not Trample the Budding Economy” (李대통령 “삼전 등 초과이윤 논쟁 신중해야… 이제 트는 경제 새싹 밟을라”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Excess Profit Debates Over Samsung Electronics Must Be Handled with Caution… We Must Not Trample the Budding Economy” (李대통령 “삼전 등 초과이윤 논쟁 신중해야… 이제 트는 경제 새싹 밟을라”)

During his first-anniversary press conference, President Lee Jae-myung addressed the recent debate over large corporations’ “excess profit distribution” that has emerged amid the labor-management conflict at Samsung Electronics. He urged the utmost caution, stating, “If handled poorly, we could end up trampling the tender shoots of an economy that has only just begun to stand and grow.” (이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자간담회에서 최근 삼성전자 노사 갈등 과정에서 화두로 떠오른 대기업의 ‘초과이윤 배분’ 논쟁과 관련해 “자칫 잘못하면 이제 겨우 일어서며 자라나고 있는 경제의 새싹을 밟는 상황이 발생할 수 있다”며 극도로 신중한 접근을 주문했다.)

Referring to the recent labor dispute at Samsung Electronics over performance bonuses and demands for a share of operating profit margins, President Lee remarked, “A very vibrant and unprecedented situation has arrived—something that was unimaginable under the old labor movements or industrial economic systems.” (이 대통령은 최근 삼성전자의 성과급 및 영업이익률 배당 요구를 둘러싼 노사 갈등을 언급하며 “과거 기성 노동운동이나 산업경제 체제에서는 상상하지 못했던 아주 발랄하고 새로운 상황이 도래했다”고 진단했다.)

President Lee explained, “In the past, a company with an operating profit margin of just over 10% was considered extremely successful. But now, we are seeing companies with operating profit margins exceeding 75%—where nearly everything sold is pure profit. There is a debate over whether this excess profit belongs solely to the individual company, or whether it also includes the contributions of workers, the share of investors, and the stake of the nation and its people, who have provided massive R&D investments and tens of trillions of won in tax cuts and subsidies during difficult times.” (이 대통령은 “과거에는 기업 영업이익률이 10%만 넘어도 엄청나게 잘 되는 기업이었는데, 이제는 파는 게 다 남는 수준인 영업이익률 75% 초과 기업들이 등장하고 있다”며 “이 초과이윤이 전부 개별 기업만의 것이냐에 대해서는 노동자의 기여, 투자자의 몫뿐만 아니라 R&D에 대대적으로 투자하고 어려운 시기에 수십 조 원의 감세와 보조금을 지원한 국가와 국민의 몫도 존재한다는 논쟁이 있다”고 설명했다.)

However, he acknowledged a significant legal and conceptual dilemma regarding whether to recognize this as an institutional right. “I’ve spent a lot of time pondering whether this is a valid argument, or if it falls under so-called ‘management rights’ and should be excluded from labor disputes. But I have yet to reach a conclusion,” he said. (다만 이를 제도적 권리로 인정할 것인가에 대해서는 법적·개념적 딜레마가 상당함을 토로했다. 이 대통령은 “이게 과연 타당한 주장인지, 소위 ‘경영권’에 해당해 노동쟁의의 대상에서 제외되는 사안은 아닌지 참 고민을 많이 했지만 아직 결론을 내지 못했다”고 했다.)

What President Lee was most wary of was the “unpredictability” that could result from unilateral revisions to domestic tax laws or social pressures. (이 대통령이 가장 경계한 부분은 일방적인 국내 세법 개정이나 사회적 압박이 가져올 ‘예측 불가능성’이었다.)

“Tax increases, such as corporate tax hikes, are stipulated by law and can be reasonably predicted by companies. But a structure where every few percentage points of distribution must be decided through confrontation is highly unstable and difficult to forecast,” President Lee warned. “Such demands could have a very serious impact on the nation’s industrial policies.” (이 대통령은 “법인세 인상 같은 경우는 법으로 예정되어 있어 기업이 합리적으로 예측할 수 있지만, 매번 몇 퍼센트를 나눠 가질지 싸움을 통해 결정해야 하는 구조는 매우 불안정하고 예측하기 어렵다”며 “이러한 요구가 국가 산업 정책에 매우 심각한 영향을 미칠 수 있다”고 경고했다.)

In particular, he cautioned against the potential isolation of the Korean market amid the global technology competition. “If our country unilaterally enforces such profit distribution or exerts social pressure, leading domestic high-tech companies may flee abroad, and foreign high-tech firms may also hesitate to invest in Korea,” President Lee said. He added rhetorically, “If there’s a burden that a portion of profits must always be given away when coming to Korea, which company would not think twice about investing?” (특히 글로벌 기술 경쟁 환경 속에서 한국 시장의 고립 가능성을 경고했다. 이 대통령은 “우리나라만 먼저 이런 이윤 분배를 강제하거나 사회적 압력을 가하면, 국내 유력 첨단 기업들이 해외로 탈출하고 해외 첨단 기업들 역시 국내 투자를 꺼리게 될 것”이라며 “한국에 가면 이익의 일부를 무조건 떼어주어야 한다는 부담이 있는데 어느 기업이 선뜻 투자를 망설이지 않겠느냐”고 반문했다.)

President Lee viewed this issue as an extension of the arguments once made by Silicon Valley tech entrepreneurs—such as the AI tax, robot tax, and the theory of basic income aimed at creating effective demand. This suggests that the academic and market logic that proper social redistribution of excess profits is necessary for a virtuous cycle in capitalism is gradually becoming a reality. (이 대통령은 이 문제를 과거 실리콘밸리 테크 기업가들이 주장했던 인공지능(AI)세, 로봇세, 그리고 이를 바탕으로 유효 수요를 창출하자는 ‘기본소득론’의 연장선으로 바라봤다. 초과 이윤의 적절한 사회적 순환이 자본주의 선순환을 위해 필요하다는 학술적·시장적 논리 자체는 점차 현실이 되어가고 있다는 뜻이다.)

However, President Lee drew a line, saying, “This is not an issue to be debated and settled solely within our country; it affects the entire international trade order and must be addressed as a global common agenda.” He envisioned that a global standard must first be agreed upon to prevent harm to domestic companies. (그러나 이 대통령은 “이 문제는 우리나라 안에서만 논쟁해서 끝낼 일이 아니며 국제 무역 질서 전체에 영향을 미치기 때문에 전 세계적인 공통 의제로 다루어져야 한다”고 선을 그었다. 국제적 표준(Global Standard)의 합의가 선행되어야 자국 기업의 피해를 막을 수 있다는 구상이다.)

President Lee repeatedly emphasized, “We are currently in a phase where the tender shoots of high-tech industries are just beginning to grow. We must approach the issue of handling excess profits with extreme caution, and we must not trample these shoots through misguided domestic overregulation.” He added, “This is a very difficult topic and an unavoidable reality, but for now, it is best for the government to refrain from speaking too much on this debate and to observe it carefully.” <<>> (이 대통령은 “지금은 겨우 일어서는 첨단 산업의 새싹이 자라나고 있는 중”이라며 “이 초과이윤 처리 문제에 대해서는 논의 자체를 매우 신중하게 접근해야 하며, 자칫 잘못된 국내 과속 규제로 새싹을 밟아서는 안 된다”고 거듭 강조했다. 이어 “매우 어려운 주제이고 피할 수 없는 현실이지만, 정부 차원에서는 당분간 이 논쟁에 대해 웬만하면 말을 아끼고 신중하게 지켜보는 것이 좋다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Kim Yeong-bae of the DP on Jang Dong-hyuk’s call for a re-election: “If Oh Se-hoon resigns, a by-election will be held” (與 김영배, 장동혁 재선거 주장에 “오세훈 사퇴하면 보궐선거”)
item.description:
Kim Yeong-bae of the DP on Jang Dong-hyuk’s call for a re-election: “If Oh Se-hoon resigns, a by-election will be held” (與 김영배, 장동혁 재선거 주장에 “오세훈 사퇴하면 보궐선거”)

On the 8th, Rep. Kim Yeong-bae of the Democratic Party of Korea, responding to Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon’s claim of President Lee Jae-myung’s responsibility for the ballot shortage and People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s call for a re-election, stated, “Simply put, if Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon himself resigns, a by-election will be held.” (더불어민주당 김영배 의원은 8일 오세훈 서울시장이 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 이재명 대통령 책임론을 주장하고, 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 재선거를 주장하는 것에 대해 “간명하게 오세훈 서울시장 본인이 사퇴하면 보궐선거가 치러지게 된다”고 했다.)

On Facebook that day, Rep. Kim said, “If Mayor Oh believes that political circles, not the election commission, should take unlimited responsibility for the ballot shortage, there is another thing to do: accept leader Jang’s call for a re-election in Seoul.” (김 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “오 시장이 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 선관위가 아니라 정치권이 무한 책임을 져야 한다고 믿는다면 해야 할 일은 따로 있다. 바로 장 대표의 서울시 재선거 주장을 수용하는 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Rep. Kim added, “Mayor Oh is a five-term Seoul mayor and a lawyer by background, so he cannot be unaware that the election commission is a constitutionally independent body, with its operations and responsibilities separate from the president and the government. Both leader Jang and Mayor Oh must know that whether to hold a re-vote is determined by the election commission based on whether it affects the outcome of the election under the Public Official Election Act, and if there is a lawsuit contesting it, the Supreme Court rules in a single-trial system.” (김 의원은 “오 시장은 서울시장 5선에 변호사 출신이므로, 선관위는 헌법상 독립기관으로 그 운영과 책임이 대통령과 정부로부터 분리돼 있다는 사실을 모를 리 없다”며 “재투표 여부는 공직선거법에 따라 당락에 영향을 미치는 여부를 선관위가 판단해 결정하고, 이에 대한 불복 소송이 있는 경우 대법원이 단심제로 판단하게 돼 있다는 것을 장 대표도 오 시장도 잘 알 것”이라고 했다.)

He said, “Despite this, Mayor Oh’s persistent targeting of the president can only be explained as a flare-up of his ‘Oh Se-hoon Syndrome’ or ‘Presidential Ambition Syndrome,’ through which he seeks to assert himself as a presidential hopeful and the party’s flagship figure. Isn’t this the very symptom that flared up in 2011 when he pushed for a referendum opposing free eco-friendly school meals, risking his mayoral position, and ultimately led to his nearly decade-long exit from politics?” (그는 “그럼에도 오 시장이 굳이 대통령을 걸고넘어지는 저의는 결국 본인이 대권 주자이자 당의 간판이라고 내세우고 싶은 ‘오세훈병’ ‘대권병’이 도진 것 외에는 설명하기 어렵다”며 “2011년 친환경 무상급식을 반대하며 서울시장 자리를 건 주민투표를 강행하고, 결국 10년 가까이 정치권에서 퇴장당했던 바로 그 증상이 도지는 상황 아닌가”라고 했다.)

Rep. Kim urged, “Rather than engaging in wasteful political strife, Mayor Oh should first head to sites like the missing rebar incident at GTX-A and the Seodaemun overpass disaster to attend to public safety administration delayed by the election. I also hope he diligently prepares for the resumption of his trial on the 10th regarding charges of violating the Political Funds Act.” (김 의원은 “오 시장은 소모적 정쟁이 아니라, GTX-A 철근 누락 현장과 서대문 고가 참사 현장 등 시민 안전의 현장에 나가 선거 때문에 지체된 안전 행정을 챙기는 일을 먼저 해야 한다”며 “더불어 10일부터 재개되는 본인의 정치자금법 위반 혐의 관련 재판 준비도 충실히 하길 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Holding taxes are generally low... Real estate tax system could be finalized by July” (李대통령 “보유세 대체로 낮아... 부동산 세제 7월 정리 가능”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Holding taxes are generally low... Real estate tax system could be finalized by July” (李대통령 “보유세 대체로 낮아... 부동산 세제 7월 정리 가능”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th, regarding analysis that rising real estate prices in the Seoul metropolitan area had negatively impacted the June 3 local elections, “I think there were rather more positive effects than negative ones,” adding, “If I hadn’t used what’s called ‘verbal intervention’ since January to keep things in check, there would have been a massive surge.” (이재명 대통령은 8일 수도권 부동산 가격 상승이 6·3 지방선거에 악영향을 미쳤다는 분석에 대해 “나쁜 영향보다는 좋은 영향이 차라리 더 많지 않았나 싶다”며 “제가 1월 달부터 소위 말하는 ‘구두 개입’을 통해 눌러놓지 않았으면 엄청난 폭등을 했을 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a press conference marking his first year in office, held at the Cheongwadae Guest House, saying, “(The impact of real estate prices on the local elections) was a constant factor. That’s only natural.” He added, “Real estate prices are already a major issue in Seoul, and I believe I’ve managed to curb upward pressure quite well.” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “(지방선거에서의 부동산 값 영향은) 상수였다고 본다. 그건 당연한 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “부동산 가격은 이미 서울의 주요 의제이고, 저는 나름 상승 압력을 잘 막아왔다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Regarding holding taxes, President Lee said, “Korea’s holding taxes are generally low,” and argued, “We should protect homes used for residence, but if they have become luxury goods, it’s right to impose a holding burden comparable to that of advanced Western countries.” (이 대통령은 보유세에 대해서도 “우리나라 보유세가 대체로 낮다”며 “거주 용도로 주택을 가지고 있는 건 보호해야하지만, 그게 사치품이 돼 있다면 서구 선진국이 하는 것 만큼의 보유 부담을 갖게 하는 것이 맞겠다”고 했다.)

He stated, “I plan to organize and announce tax policies, financial measures, regulations, and supply all together soon,” adding, “Tax issues will only be possible by July, and matters of increasing supply will be organized and announced soon by speeding up the process.” In particular, he noted that housing supply had sharply decreased during the Yoon Seok-yeol administration. He said, “I try to avoid badmouthing others, but supply saw a sharp decline over the three years from 2022 to 2024,” and vowed, “I will accelerate the pace, whether through new construction, land development, reconstruction, or redevelopment, to get it done quickly.” (그는 “세제, 금융, 규제, 공급을 정리해 조만간 한꺼번에 (발표)하려고 한다”며 “세제 문제는 7월 달이 돼야 가능할 것이고, 공급을 늘리는 문제는 속도를 빨리 내는 걸로 조만간 정리해서 발표하게 될 것”이라고 했다. 특히 윤석열 정부 때 주택 공급이 급격하게 줄었다고 했다. 그는 “가급적 남 얘기를 나쁘게 안 하려고 하는데, 2022~2024년 3년 동안 공급이 확 줄었다”며 “속도를 내서 신축이든 택지개발이든 재건축 재개발이든 속도를 내서 빨리 하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding financial measures, he said, “Let’s block real estate speculation with others’ money,” adding, “It doesn’t help the national economy. One day, financial institutions could face major accidents. Let’s reduce credit loans or mortgage loans a bit.” (금융 대책과 관련해선 “남의 돈으로 부동산 투기하는 것은 막자”며 “국가 경제에 도움이 안 된다. 언젠가는 금융기관도 대형사고가 나는 수가 있다. 신용 대출 또는 담보 대출을 좀 줄이자”고 했다.)

On the jeonse (key money deposit) system, he described it as “a unique financial technique that is now on the decline,” and argued, “It’s currently distorting the market.” He continued, “Providing a lot of jeonse loans has been a major cause of rising home prices,” and stated, “A normalization process is needed.” Regarding claims that jeonse prices have surged due to a decrease in jeonse supply, he said, “It’s natural that jeonse supply has decreased,” and added, “That’s logic created by people who want such a situation.” (전세 제도에 대해선 “특이한 금융 기법으로, 이제는 사라져가는 추세”라며 “이게 지금 시장을 왜곡하고 있는 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “전세대출을 많이 해준 게 집값 상승의 주요 원인”이라며 “정상화되는 과정이 필요하다”고 했다. 전세 물량이 감소해 전셋값이 폭등했다는 주장에 대해선 “전세 물량이 준 것은 당연하다”며 “그런 상황을 원하는 사람이 만든 논리”라고 했다.)

President Lee also touched on the phenomenon of real estate prices rising when the Democratic Party of Korea comes to power. He said, “It’s strange, but when so-called reform governments take office, prices go up, and when conservative governments are in power, even if they hold rituals to boost real estate prices, they don’t rise,” adding, “(Under conservative administrations), even if they ease collateral, lower interest rates, and hold rituals encouraging people to go into debt to buy homes, prices just don’t rise.” (이 대통령은 더불어민주당이 집권하면 부동산 가격에 오르는 현상에 대해서도 언급했다. 그는 “부동산은 묘하게 소위 개혁 정부가 들어서면 올라가고, 보수 정부에서 집권을 하면 부동산 값을 올리려고 고사를 지내는데도 안 올라간다“며 ”(보수 정권에서) 담보도 풀어주고 이자율도 낮추고 빚 내서 집 사라고 고사를 지내도 안 오른다“고 했다.)

He continued, “They don’t rise, then they accumulate and pile up for years, and when a reform government takes office, they suddenly surge,” noting, “After experiencing this several times, it’s odd—though there’s no real connection—but such a bias has emerged. I believe we need to break this vicious cycle.” <<>> (이어 “안 오르고 있다가 그게 몇 년 동안 쌓이고 쌓여서 개혁 정부가 들어서면 그때 확 올라란다”며 “이게 몇 번 경험이 쌓이다 보니까 이상하게 아무 관계가 없지만 그런 선입관이 생겨났다. 저는 이 악순환의 고리를 끊어야 된다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "KOSPI Still Undervalued" (李대통령 “코스피 여전히 저평가된 상태”)
item.description:
President Lee: "KOSPI Still Undervalued" (李대통령 “코스피 여전히 저평가된 상태”)

At a press conference marking his first anniversary in office, President Lee Jae-myung addressed the recent volatility of the KOSPI around the 8,000-point level, diagnosing it as "not a crash, but a normal process of finding an appropriate price equilibrium and a breather." He stated, "The previously suppressed Korean capital market is regaining its footing through measures to normalize anomalies, coupled with the semiconductor boom, and it remains undervalued." (이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자간담회에서 최근 코스피(KOSPI) 8000선 안팎의 시장 변동성을 두고 “대폭락이 아니라 적정한 가격 균형점을 찾아가는 정상적인 과정이자 숨고르기”라며 “그동안 억눌렸던 한국 자본시장은 비정상의 정상화 조치와 반도체 특수가 맞물려 제자리를 찾아가고 있으며, 여전히 저평가된 상태”라고 진단했다.)

President Lee attributed the much faster-than-expected revitalization of the capital market, compared to his initial mid-term target index levels, to the "restoration of trust between the government and the market." (이 대통령은 당초 임기 중반기 목표로 예상했던 지수대보다 훨씬 빠른 속도로 자본시장이 활성화된 배경으로 ‘정부와 시장의 신뢰 회복’을 꼽았다.)

President Lee said, "Achieving the 5,000-point mark on the stock index was something I timidly promised, expecting it only after two to three years, but it happened in just six months." He added, "This wasn't created by force; it was a process of normalizing anomalies that had been excessively suppressed. So, once the market gained confidence, it bounced back to normal like a spring." (이 대통령은 “주가지수 5000선 달성은 한 2~3년 지난 다음에나 기대하며 소심하게 공약했던 것인데, 단 6개월 만에 이뤄졌다”며 “새로운 상황을 억지로 만든 것이 아니라 그동안 과도하게 억눌려 있던 ‘비정상의 정상화’ 과정이었기 때문에, 시장이 확신을 갖는 순간 용수철처럼 정상을 찾아 올라간 것”이라고 했다.)

In particular, he directly refuted the vested interests' logic that had attributed the Korea Discount solely to geopolitical risks. President Lee stated, "In the past, the Korean market was evaluated at best at only about 60% of its intrinsic value. If it were due to diplomatic and security instability, the soaring performance of the Taiwanese market would be inexplicable. The real cause lay in abnormal market disruption practices." (특히 그간 코리아 디스카운트의 원인으로 지정학적 리스크만 탓하던 기득권의 논리를 정면으로 반박했다. 이 대통령은 “과거 한국 시장은 잘해 봐야 본값의 60% 정도밖에 평가를 못 받았다”며 “외교·안보적 불안정 때문이라면 대만 시장의 고공 행진을 설명할 수가 없다. 진짜 원인은 비정상적인 시장 교란 행위에 있었다”고 했다.)

Regarding the recent phenomenon of a concurrent rise in the won-dollar exchange rate (depreciation of the won) alongside a stock market surge, President Lee argued that it is a temporary illusion caused by a mechanical 'rebalancing' of global funds in the wake of a sharp short-term rally. (이 대통령은 최근 주식시장 폭등과 함께 환율이 동반 상승(원화 가치 하락)하는 현상에 대해서는 단기 급등에 따른 글로벌 자금의 기계적 ‘리밸런싱(자산 재배분)’ 과정에서 나타난 일시적 착시라고 주장했다.)

President Lee explained, "Because stock prices have risen too fast and too much, it's having an unusual effect on the foreign exchange market. Overseas funds have internal rules setting their ratio of Korean stocks, but as semiconductor large-cap stocks surged by 5 to 6 times, that ratio suddenly grew to 10 percent." He continued, "In the end, to balance the funds, foreigners sold some stocks and converted them into dollars, which merely stimulated the exchange rate." (이 대통령은 “주가가 너무 빨리 많이 오르다 보니 외환시장에 이상한 영향을 미치고 있다”며 “해외 펀드들은 내규상 한국 주식 비율을 정해두는데, 반도체 대형주 중심으로 주가가 5~6배씩 뛰면서 그 비율이 순식간에 10%까지 커져 버린 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “결국 펀드 밸런스를 맞추기 위해 외국인들이 주식을 일부 매도하고 이를 달러로 환전해 나가는 과정에서 환율이 자극받은 것일 뿐”이라고 진단했다.)

He dismissed concerns of a crisis from some market corners by presenting unprecedented current account surplus figures. President Lee emphasized, "Currently, South Korea is recording a massive current account surplus of a scale we have never experienced before, already surpassing the annual forecast. While there may be fluctuations from profit-taking or nervous funds taking a breather, considering the strong fundamentals, Korean stocks are still undervalued." (시장 일각의 위기론에 대해서는 전례 없는 경상수지 흑자 지표를 제시하며 일축했다. 이 대통령은 “현재 대한민국은 한 번도 겪어보지 못한 엄청난 규모의 경상수지 흑자를 기록하고 있으며, 이미 연간 예측치를 넘어서 버렸다”며 “이익 실현 매물이나 불안한 자금들이 잠시 쉬어가는 진폭은 있겠지만, 강력한 펀더멘털을 고려할 때 한국 주식은 아직도 저평가되어 있다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: Lee: “I Respect the Youths Who Pointed Out the Ballot Shortage… ‘Lack of Sovereignty Sensitivity’—I Also Reflect on That” (李 “투표용지 지적 청년들 존경... ‘주권 감수성 부족’ 저도 반성”)
item.description:
Lee: “I Respect the Youths Who Pointed Out the Ballot Shortage… ‘Lack of Sovereignty Sensitivity’—I Also Reflect on That” (李 “투표용지 지적 청년들 존경... ‘주권 감수성 부족’ 저도 반성”)

During a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration, President Lee Jae-myung strongly criticized the recent “ballot shortage” incident that occurred in the early voting and main voting processes of the local elections, calling it “an absurd event that instantly shattered the honor of cutting-edge South Korea as a model democratic nation.” President Lee defined the incident as an infringement on sovereignty and a flaw in the constitutional system, announcing the launch of a joint investigation task force for compulsory probes and the convening of an emergency meeting of national leaders to establish fundamental countermeasures. <<> In response to a question from a Singaporean Straits Times reporter about the protests related to the local elections and measures to address the ballot shortage, President Lee expressed repeated regret, stating, “It’s a shocking event that even countries with lower levels of democratic development would find hard to imagine,” continuing his sentiments from the previous day. <<> In particular, President Lee highly praised the young people who took to the streets in anger over the incident and the university student council presidents who raised the issue. “To be honest, I initially thought somewhat complacently, ‘Only a dozen or so people couldn’t vote, and it won’t affect the election results…’” he said. “But after seeing the youths’ pointed criticisms, I felt a reflection that my own sensitivity to national sovereignty—my ‘sovereignty awareness’—was significantly lacking.” <<> President Lee stated, “This issue is not about the number of votes or election outcomes but a fundamental matter of principle: in the democratic republic of South Korea, the state obstructed the people’s exercise of sovereignty by handling things carelessly without proper measures.” He added, “This is entirely different from the existing ‘election fraud instigation’ forces that distort facts for political purposes. I am rather grateful to the youths who reminded us of a principle we nearly glossed over.” <<> President Lee strongly criticized the incompetence and structural insularity of the National Election Commission (NEC), which neglected the situation. “Reports of a ballot shortage came out as early as 2 p.m., yet the NEC left it unaddressed without any countermeasures—it’s so pathetic that it makes one wonder if it was intentional,” he said. <<> He particularly targeted the fact that the NEC, as an independent agency, has evaded external oversight. “The NEC, being a constitutionally independent agency, has been determined not to be subject to audits by the Board of Audit and Inspection. The executive branch can only allocate its budget but cannot intervene in or even inquire about its operations,” President Lee noted, pointing out the structural blind spot. <<> Given the impossibility of an internal audit by the executive branch, President Lee opted for “judicial procedures.” “At the very least, shouldn’t we uncover the truth of whether it was intentional?” he said. “Since a complaint has already been filed, I have mobilized all available administrative authority to form a ‘joint investigation task force’ and ordered swift and rigorous investigations to determine whether criminal charges are applicable.” (이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자간담회에서 최근 지방선거 사전투표 및 본투표 과정에서 발생한 ‘투표지 부족 사태’와 관련해 “첨단 대한민국, 모범적 민주국가의 명예를 한순간에 깡그리 망가뜨린 어처구니없는 일”이라며 강한 어조로 비판했다. 이 대통령은 이번 사태를 주권 침해이자 헌정 시스템의 결함으로 규정하고, 합동수사본부를 통한 강제 수사와 함께 국가 요인 긴급 회동을 통한 근본적 대책 마련에 착수했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Deputy Policy Committee Chair of the Ruling Party: "If Jung Won-oh Had Been Elected, There Would Have Been Bloodshed... A By-Election Should Be Held" (與 정책위 부의장 “정원오 당선됐으면 유혈사태…재선거해야”)
item.description:
Deputy Policy Committee Chair of the Ruling Party: "If Jung Won-oh Had Been Elected, There Would Have Been Bloodshed... A By-Election Should Be Held" (與 정책위 부의장 “정원오 당선됐으면 유혈사태…재선거해야”)

Jeong Min-cheol, Deputy Chair of the Policy Committee of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 8th, "If Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh had been elected, there would have been bloodshed," adding, "I believe a by-election should be held." (더불어민주당 정민철 정책위 부의장은 8일 “정원오 서울시장 후보가 만약 당선됐다면 유혈 사태가 일어났을 것”이라며 “재선거를 해야 한다고 본다”고 했다.)

Deputy Chair Jeong stated this on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang," saying, "Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon is avoiding demands for a by-election. The conservative support base is extremely angry about this." (정 부의장은 이날 YTN라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에서 “오세훈 서울시장이 재선거 요구를 회피하고 있다. 보수 지지층이 여기에 굉장히 분노하고 있다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Deputy Chair Jeong said, "I'm not hoping that Mayor Oh will pursue a lawsuit regarding the by-election demands. But can't he at least state his position on what he thinks about the by-election demands?" and "He is continuously avoiding any stance on the by-election demands." He added, "If Mayor Oh wants to become a major influential figure in the conservative camp, he must respond to the by-election demands from his support base." (정 부의장은 “오 시장이 재선거 요구에 대해서 소송을 진행하는 걸 바라는 것도 아니다. 재선거 요구에 대해 어떻게 생각하는지 본인의 입장 정도는 밝힐 수 있지 않나”라며 “(오 시장이) 끊임없이 재선거 요구에는 모든 입장을 회피하고 있다”고 했다. 그는 “(오 시장이) 보수의 주요한 유력 정치인이 되고 싶다면 지지층의 재선거 요구에는 응답해야 한다”고 했다.)

Deputy Chair Jeong said, "I believe a by-election should be held," but also noted, "There are many aspects to consider regarding the method of the by-election." He said, "I think the nationwide call for a by-election is a means for People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to evade his political responsibility," but added, "It is true that young people and citizens are calling for a by-election, and Seoul is a representative place where such demands are pouring in. So Mayor Oh must respond to this, so that the next discussions can proceed in the government or the National Assembly." (정 부의장은 “재선거를 해야 한다고 본다”면서도 “재선거의 방식은 굉장히 살펴볼 게 많다”고 했다. 그는 “전국적 재선거 주장은 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 본인의 정치적 책임을 회피하기 위한 수단이라고 생각한다”면서도 “청년과 국민들의 재선거 요구가 있는 것은 사실이고, 서울이 대표적으로 재선거 요구가 빗발치는 곳이니 오 시장이 여기에 답변해야 그다음 논의를 정부나 국회에서 진행할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "My Criticism of Israel Was Not Out of Anger" (李 “이스라엘 지적, 욱해서 한 거 아니다”)
item.description:
Lee: "My Criticism of Israel Was Not Out of Anger" (李 “이스라엘 지적, 욱해서 한 거 아니다”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th regarding his recent repeated criticisms of Israel, "It was not done out of anger," adding, "I tried to hold back, but it was too much, so I pointed it out." (이재명 대통령은 8일 최근 이스라엘을 잇따라 비판한 것에 대해 “욱해서 한 게 아니다”라며 “안 하려고 하다가 해도 해도 너무 해서 지적을 한 것”이라고 했다.)

The President responded this way to a foreign journalist's question about his stance on remarks related to Israel during a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House. Last month, President Lee targeted Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, saying, "Isn't he recognized as a war criminal by the International Criminal Court (ICC) with an arrest warrant issued?" and suggested reviewing measures to arrest him if he enters South Korea. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 이스라엘 관련 발언에 대한 입장을 묻는 외신 기자의 질문에 이같이 답했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리를 겨냥해 “국제형사재판소(ICC) 전범으로 인정돼 체포 영장이 발부돼 있는 것 아니냐”며 한국에 들어올 경우 체포하는 방안을 검토하자고 한 바 있다.)

President Lee mentioned "national sovereignty, universal human rights, and international norms," stating, "There are occasionally points where all three are not respected and are undermined." He continued, "Didn't the Israeli military effectively kidnap our citizens on the high seas, where freedom of navigation is guaranteed?" and asked, "And weren't there unacceptable human rights violations that are hard to understand?" He added, "So, because this involves a violation of sovereignty, a breach of international norms, and a human rights violation, I pointed out the issue." (이 대통령은 ‘국가 주권, 보편적 인권, 국제 규범’을 언급하며 “이 세 가지가 다 존중받지 못하고 훼손되는 지점들이 가끔씩 있다”고 했다. 이어 “(이스라엘군이) 우리 국민을 항행의 자유가 보장되는 공해상에서 사실상 납치한 것 아니냐”라며 “거기다가 쉽게 납득할 수 없는, 용인할 수 없는 인권 침해 행위가 있었다는 거 아닌가”라고 했다. 그러면서 “그래서 이건 주권의 침해이기도 하고, 국제 규범 위반이기도 하고 인권 침해기도 해서 제가 문제 지적을 한 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the incident where our vessel, the NAMUHO, was struck by an Iranian missile in the Strait of Hormuz, he said, "There are oddly multiple complex factors. Iran denies that such an event occurred," adding, "It's certain that it wasn't done with intent." He further remarked, "Normally, if a missile hits, a ship would sink, but in this case, it was just a slight explosion," concluding, "This is quite strange." <<>> (이란 미사일에 의해 호르무즈 해협에서 우리 나무호가 피격된 것에 대해선 “묘하게 여러 복합적이 요소가 있다. 이란은 그런 일이 없다고 부인한다”라며 “의도를 가지고 한 건 아닌 건 확실하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “보통 미사일이 맞으면 침몰해야 되는데, 살짝 터진 정도에 불과하다”며 “이게 좀 이상하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "In Golf and Elections, if You Lift Your Head, You Lose... It’s a Warning from the People" (李 “골프와 선거는 고개들면 져... 국민의 경고”)
item.description:
Lee: "In Golf and Elections, if You Lift Your Head, You Lose... It’s a Warning from the People" (李 “골프와 선거는 고개들면 져... 국민의 경고” )

Regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, President Lee Jae-myung assessed, "If you lose where you were supposed to win, and lose where you had to win, that’s a different problem," adding, "These election results are, at the very least, not a success." He also said, "For about two or three days (after the election), I wasn’t in great shape myself," and concluded, "The bottom line is my own inadequacy." <<> President Lee made these remarks on the 5th during a press conference marking his first anniversary in office, held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, in response to questions about evaluating the local elections and potential shifts in his governance approach. <<> While acknowledging that the criteria for judging election outcomes may vary by perspective, President Lee did not hide his regret over his party’s performance. He stated, "Whether winning a majority of seats or exceeding ten seats constitutes a win depends on the standard," but firmly noted, "However, if you lose where you should win, or lose where you must win, that’s a different matter, and it’s at least not a success." <<> President Lee, who previously emphasized "a winning party, a capable party, a strong party" during his tenure as leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, candidly shared his feelings, saying, "During the election process, I genuinely tried to uphold my duty of neutrality, but my facial expressions didn’t quite remain neutral," eliciting laughter from the press corps. <<> President Lee remarked, "An election is something you barely manage even with all your might, and I believe it’s akin to performing a ritual for the heavens," adding, "Assemblyman Park Ji-won of the Democratic Party occasionally says, ‘In golf and elections, if you lift your head, you lose.’" He continued, "I admit there was a side of me that thought too lightly of it," and "I felt I need to work harder. For about two to three days, I wasn’t in great shape myself." <<> Regarding the attitude a ruling party should maintain, President Lee used the analogy of a "spear and a bowl" to explain the roles of the ruling and opposition parties. <<> President Lee emphasized, "The opposition party, which is on the offensive, must wield the spear skillfully and strike effectively, but the ruling party, which defends the fortress, should become a ‘bowl’ of embrace and unity that gathers people inside the castle." He added, "You should not insult those who enter the house for having different thoughts, nor subject them to ideological censorship." <<> Specifically targeting the harsh rhetoric in some political circles, he defined "true strength." item.title: President Lee: "There is a Practical Need for a Korea-Japan Military Logistics Agreement" (李대통령 “한일군수지원협정, 현실적 필요성은 있어”)
item.description:
President Lee: "There is a Practical Need for a Korea-Japan Military Logistics Agreement" (李대통령 “한일군수지원협정, 현실적 필요성은 있어”)

President Lee Jae-myung, during a press conference on the 5th marking his first year in office, acknowledged "a practical need" for a potential Korea-Japan Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA), while drawing a clear line against early pursuit of the deal given unresolved public sentiment and historical grievances. Using his characteristic blunt metaphors, the President emphasized that a sincere apology from Japan must come first for genuine security cooperation to be possible. (이재명 대통령은 5일 취임 1주년 기자간담회에서 한일 군수지원협정(ACSA) 체결 가능성에 대해 “현실적인 필요성이 있다”고 인정하면서도, 국민적 정서와 역사적 앙금이 해소되지 않은 상황에서의 조기 추진에는 분명한 선을 그었다. 이 대통령은 특유의 직설적인 비유를 들어 일본의 진심 어린 사과가 선행되어야 진정한 안보 협력이 가능하다고 강조했다.)

In response to queries from foreign and domestic media about Korea-U.S.-Japan security cooperation, President Lee stated, "Regarding the military logistics agreement issue, the people of South Korea are thinking, 'What nonsense is this?'" He added, "As I see it, there is a practical need. But that's all it is—a practical need. Given the public's sentiments, it's difficult to accept this at the present time." (이 대통령은 외신과 국내 언론의 한미일 안보 공조 질의 과정에서 “군수지원협정 이 문제도 대한민국 국민들은 ‘뭔 소리냐’라고 생각하신다”며 “내가 보기에는 현실적인 필요성이 있다. 그러나 그것은 현실적 필요성일 뿐이고, 우리는 국민들의 정서상 이것을 받아들이기가 현재로서는 어렵다”고 했다.)

President Lee remarked, "If I speak openly about this (the need), I'll get in trouble," and noted, "I have clearly conveyed to the Japanese side, 'You must also understand the emotional position of our people.'" This implies that even if there are security benefits, it's hard to push forward without public consensus. (이 대통령은 “이런 얘기(필요성)를 공개적으로 하면 나 혼난다”며 “일본 측에도 ‘우리 국민의 이러한 정서적 입장도 이해하셔야 한다’고 명확히 전달했다”고 밝혔다. 안보적 이익이 존재하더라도 국민적 공감대 없이는 추진하기 어렵다는 뜻이다.)

President Lee identified the fundamental reason for the lack of progress in Korea-Japan military cooperation as stemming from the Japanese government's 'attitude' regarding historical issues. To illustrate this, he used an analogy of 'a punch and medical bills.' (이 대통령은 한일 군사 협력이 진전되지 못하는 근본적인 원인을 과거사 문제에 대한 일본 정부의 ‘태도’에서 찾았다. 이를 설명하기 위해 ‘주먹질과 치료비’라는 비유를 들었다.)

President Lee said, "Clearly, in the past, you threw a punch, and I was hit. I remember getting hit and having my eye swollen. I paid the medical bills and couldn't work because of it." He then questioned, "Now, if you say, 'Let's be friends,' we might get along because it's necessary, but can we truly achieve complete cooperation?" (이 대통령은 “분명히 과거에 주먹질을 해서 내가 맞았고, 맞아가지고 눈도 터진 기억이 있다. 치료비도 내고 일도 못 하고 그랬다”며 “이제 와서 ‘우리 친하게 지내자’고 하면, 필요하니까 일단 친하게는 지내겠지만 진짜로 완전한 협력을 할 수 있겠느냐”고 반문했다.)

He continued, "To become real friends, you'd have to say, 'I'm sorry I hit you before, truly. Did it hurt back then? Did the medical bills cost a lot? I won't hit you again.' Then I'd be convinced you won't hit me again." He added, "But Japan says things like, 'When did I hit you? Isn't one apology enough? Do I have to do it again? I've already done it three times—do I have to do it again?' How can we truly connect with that kind of attitude?" (이어 “진짜 친구가 되려면 ‘내가 전에 때려서 미안하다, 진짜로. 그때 아팠지? 치료비 많이 들었지? 다시는 안 때릴게’라고 해야 아, 진짜 안 때리겠구나 확신이 드는 것”이라며 “그런데 일본은 ‘내가 언제 때렸는데? 미안하다고 한 번 해줬으면 됐지 또 해야 돼? 내가 세 번이나 했는데 또 해야 돼?’라는 식인데, 이러면 어떻게 진짜 마음이 통하겠느냐”라고 했다.)

President Lee stressed that this is not just political rhetoric but "part of the deep-seated feelings of the Korean people." He firmly stated, "This isn't about money or other issues; it's thoroughly an 'emotional issue.' Do you think South Korea lacks money and is asking for old medical bills?" (이 대통령은 이것이 단순한 정치적 수사가 아닌 “대한민국 국민들 바닥에 있는 마음의 일부”라며 “이것은 돈의 문제나 다른 문제가 아니라 철저히 ‘정서의 문제’다. 대한민국이 무슨 돈이 부족해서 옛날 치료비 내놓으라고 하겠나”라고 못 박았다.)

President Lee pointed out, "From Japan's perspective, they likely want to actively strengthen Korea-U.S.-Japan or Korea-Japan military cooperation, but long-term, Northeast Asian security issues must move toward a complex multilateral security framework." He added, "Right now, the security landscape is advancing in a very confrontational manner, so there are aspects we need to be cautious about, and we need to adjust the pace a bit." (이 대통령은 “일본 입장에서는 한·미·일 또는 한·일 군사 협력을 적극적으로 강화하고 싶어 하겠지만, 동북아시아의 안보 문제는 길게 보면 복합적인 다자 안보 체계로 가야 한다”며 “지금은 안보 지형이 매우 대결적으로 진척되고 있어서 우리로서는 조심해야 할 측면들이 있고, 속도도 좀 조절해야 한다”고 짚었다.)

He also revealed details of a conversation during last month's meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Takaiichi Sanae in Andong, Gyeongsangbuk-do. President Lee shared, "I told Prime Minister Takaiichi directly, 'Korea-Japan relations are often called close yet distant, but I hope we can become close and truly close. However, we still have unresolved historical issues.'" (아울러 지난달 경북 안동에서 열린 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리와의 회담 당시 나눈 대화 비화도 공개했다. 이 대통령은 “다카이치 총리께 ‘한·일 관계는 흔히 가깝고도 먼 관계라고 하는데, 나는 가깝고도 가까운 사이가 되면 좋겠다. 하지만 아직 우리에게는 남아 있는 과거사 문제들이 있다’고 직접 말했다”고 전했다.)

Finally, President Lee said, "Essentially, because historical grievances have not been cleanly resolved, there are limits to military cooperation." He added, "But someday, we must definitely settle this to achieve a truly sincere Korea-Japan relationship. I believe the day will come when Japan sincerely says, 'I'm sorry for hitting you.'" (마지막으로 이 대통령은 “본질적으로 과거사 앙금이 깨끗이 정리된 상황이 아니기 때문에 군사 협력에 한계가 있는 것”이라며 “그러나 언젠가는 반드시 이를 정리해야 진짜 진심 어린 한일 관계가 이루어진다. 일본이 진심으로 ‘때려서 미안해’라고 말할 날이 올 것이라 믿는다” 고 했다.)

item.title: PPP Audit Committee Chairman: "Seoul mayoral election invalid... Will file an appeal with election commission" (국힘 당감위원장 “서울시장 선거 무효…선관위에 소청할 것”)
item.description:
PPP Audit Committee Chairman: "Seoul mayoral election invalid... Will file an appeal with election commission" (국힘 당감위원장 “서울시장 선거 무효…선관위에 소청할 것”)

Lee Ho-seon, chairman of the People Power Party's internal audit committee, announced on the 8th that he would file an appeal with the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission to invalidate the Seoul mayoral election, claiming it was null and void. Chairman Lee stated, "According to the Public Official Election Act, the deadline for filing an appeal is two weeks from election day," adding, "We plan to gather 63 plaintiffs by the 10th and file the appeal on the 11th." (국민의힘 이호선 당무감사위원장이 8일 서울시장 선거 무효를 주장하며 서울시 선거관리위원회에 선거 무효 소청을 내겠다고 밝혔다. 이 위원장은 이날 “공직선거법상 소청 기한이 선거일로부터 2주”라며 “10일까지 원고 63명을 모으고 11일 소청을 제기하려 한다”고 했다.)

On his blog, Chairman Lee said, "In the June 3 local elections and by-elections for National Assembly seats, 50 out of 14,288 polling stations nationwide experienced a shortage of ballots, failing to supply them properly," adding, "Among them, shortages were concentrated in 33 polling stations in Seoul alone (including 14 in Songpa District)." (이 위원장은 자신의 블로그에서 “6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서 전국 1만4288곳 투표소 중 50곳 투표소에서 투표 용지가 부족해 정상적으로 공급되지 못하는 사태가 발생했다”며 “그중 서울시에서만 33개 투표소(송파구 14곳 포함)에서 부족 사태가 집중적으로 확인됐다”고 했다.)

He argued, "The Seoul mayoral election is a metropolitan election conducted with the entire city of Seoul as a single electoral district," and "The ballot shortages that occurred at 33 polling stations were all defects in the voting process of a single election (the Seoul mayoral election), and their impact directly affects the validity of that election." (그는 “서울시장 선거는 서울시 전역을 단일 선거구로 하여 실시되는 광역 선거”라며 “33곳 투표소에서 발생한 투표 용지 부족은 모두 동일한 하나의 선거(서울시장 선거)의 투표 과정에서 발생한 하자로서, 그 영향이 서울시장 선거의 효력에 직접 귀속된다”고 했다.)

He stated, "This caused a significant number of voters who gave up voting because they did not receive ballots, as well as voters who voted in a situation where exit polls were publicly released after the normal closing time, undermining free and fair decision-making," adding, "Additionally, during the process of transporting ballot boxes with police involvement, they were moved without observers." (그는 “투표 용지를 교부받지 못해 투표를 포기한 선거인과 정상적인 투표 마감 시간 이후 출구 조사가 일반에 공개되는 상황에서 자유롭고 공정한 의사 결정이 보장되지 못한 상태에서 투표한 선거인을 다수 발생시켰다”며 “또 경찰을 투입하여 투표함을 이송하는 과정에서 참관인 없이 이송했다”고 했다.)

Chairman Lee claimed, "The Seoul mayoral election involved a serious administrative flaw—a breach of the duty to supply ballots for predictable demand by the election commission—resulting in the infringement of many voters' right to vote," and "This infringement not only likely accumulated in the vote tally of a single electoral district, affecting the election outcome, but also constitutes an independent reason for invalidation that fundamentally undermines trust in the freedom and fairness of the election, regardless of the precise calculation of individual vote differences." (이 위원장은 “서울시장 선거는 선관위의 예측 가능한 수요에 대한 투표 용지 공급 의무 위반이라는 중대한 관리상 하자로 다수 선거인의 참정권이 침해됐다”며 “그 침해는 단일 선거구의 득표 집계에 누적되어 선거의 결과에 영향을 미쳤을 개연성이 있을 뿐만 아니라, 개별 득표차의 정밀한 산정 여부와 무관하게 선거의 자유와 공정에 대한 신뢰를 그 근본에서 훼손한 독자적 무효 사유에 해당한다”고 주장했다.)

Under election law, for local elections, to claim an election is invalid, one must file an appeal with the election commission. If the commission accepts the appeal within 60 days, a re-election can be held within 30 days. If the commission dismisses or rejects the appeal, a lawsuit can be filed in court within 10 days, and the court must deliver a verdict within 180 days of the filing. (선거법상 지방선거의 경우 선거 무효를 주장하려면 선관위에 선거 소청을 하고, 선관위가 60일 내에 소청을 받아들이면 30일 내에 재선거가 가능하다. 선관위가 기각·각하 결정을 한다면 10일 내에 법원에 선거 소송을 제기할 수 있고, 법원은 소송 제기일로부터 180일 안에 판결을 내려야 한다.)

However, the election law stipulates that an election can only be declared invalid "when it is recognized to have affected the election outcome." The key criterion for determining whether a re-election is possible is whether the ballot shortage caused "a degree of voter error capable of altering the election result." (다만, 선거법은 ‘선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’에만 선거 무효를 결정하도록 하고 있다. 투표 용지 부족으로 ‘선거 결과를 바꿀 정도의 표심 오류’가 발생했는지가 재선거 가능 여부를 가르는 기준이라는 것이다.)

In response, Chairman Lee told this newspaper in a phone call, "I know there is a Supreme Court precedent stating that an election becomes invalid when a sufficient number of voters forgo voting to impact the election, but this incident is an unprecedented violation of voting rights due to the election commission's flaw," adding, "I believe a re-election should be held regardless of whether it changed the outcome." Chairman Lee stated, "This is not something I discussed with the leadership of Jang Dong-hyuk; I am simply pursuing an appeal as a citizen regarding the violation of voting rights," adding, "I am not even a member of the People Power Party." (이에 대해 이 위원장은 본지 통화에서 “투표에 영향을 미칠 정도의 투표 포기자가 발생할 때 선거 무효가 된다는 대법원 판례가 있다는 건 알지만, 이번 사태는 유례없는 선관위의 하자로 인한 심각한 투표권 침해”라며 “선거 결과를 바꿀 정도 등과 관계없이 다시 선거를 해야 한다고 본다”고 했다. 이 위원장은 “장동혁 지도부와 의논한 것은 전혀 아니고, 참정권 침해 사태에 대해 한 사람의 시민 입장에서 소청 절차를 밟는 것”이라며 “나는 국민의힘 당원도 아니다”라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "I Will Leave the Decision on Whether to Abolish the Prosecution's Supplementary Investigative Authority to the National Assembly" (李대통령 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부, 국회에 맡길 생각”)
item.description:
President Lee: "I Will Leave the Decision on Whether to Abolish the Prosecution's Supplementary Investigative Authority to the National Assembly" (李대통령 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지 여부, 국회에 맡길 생각”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigative authority, "I hope it will be handed over to the National Assembly for discussion, and the government will not insist on either side." (이재명 대통령이 8일 검찰 보완 수사권 폐지 여부와 관련해 “국회로 넘겨 논의하고 정부 입장을 어느 쪽으로 고집하지 말면 좋겠다”고 밝혔다.)

In a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee said, "Distrust in the prosecution is too great. There is also some validity to the concern that even that (supplementary investigative authority) could be abused." President Lee had previously maintained a position that the prosecution should be granted supplementary investigative authority for exceptional cases, but this remark is interpreted as a retreat from his earlier stance. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 연 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “검찰 불신이 너무 크다. 그거(보완 수사권)조차 악용하면 어쩌냐는 우려도 일리가 없지 않다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 그간 예외적인 사안에 대해 검찰에 보완 수사권을 부여해야 한다는 입장이었으나 이날 발언은 기존 입장에서 물러선 것으로 해석된다.)

President Lee added, "If, after trying it out, the people say this is not right or there are problems, we can fix it again. Right now, it seems most important to resolve the people's anxieties." He continued, "In any case, an unimaginably serious incident occurred. (The prosecution) fabricated cases, manipulated evidence, indicted people to harass them—a state should not act like this," and "There are concerns among the people that this should never happen again." (이 대통령은 “해보다가 국민들이 이건 아니다, 문제가 있어 하면 또 고치면 된다”며 “지금은 국민들의 불안감을 해소하는 게 제일 중요한 것 같다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “어쨌든 있을 수 없는 너무나 큰 일이 벌어졌다. (검찰이) 사건을 만들고 증거를 조작하고 기소해서 괴롭히고, 국가가 이러면 안 된다”며 “다시는 재발하지 않았으면 하는 걱정들이 국민들 속에 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

He went on to say, "This is truly sad. There should be a certain line that cannot be crossed, but the prosecution has crossed that line too many times and broken it down too much. I see this as karmic retribution. In any case, I plan to leave it to the National Assembly." (이어 “참 슬픈 일이다. 일정한 선을 넘지 말아야 하는데 검찰이 그 선을 너무 많이 넘어버려서, 너무 많이 망가뜨렸다”며 “업보라고 생각한다. 어쨌든 국회에 맡길 생각”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Lee: "Withdrawal of Indictment, Just Follow the Law... If It's Wrong, Correct It" (李 “공소취소, 법대로 하면 돼... 잘못됐으면 시정하는 것”)
item.description:
Lee: "Withdrawal of Indictment, Just Follow the Law... If It's Wrong, Correct It" (李 “공소취소, 법대로 하면 돼... 잘못됐으면 시정하는 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th regarding the withdrawal of the indictment in his own case, "Just follow the law and common sense," adding, "If it's wrong, withdraw it; if it's not wrong, leave it as is." (이재명 대통령은 8일 자신의 사건에 대한 공소 취소와 관련해 “법과 상식대로 하면 된다”며 “잘못됐으면 취소하고, 잘못 안 됐으면 놔두는 것”이라고 했다.)

The President made these remarks during a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration held at the Cheongwadae State Guest House. The Democratic Party of Korea has declared its intention to push for a "Special Investigation Law for Manipulated Indictments" that would grant a special counsel the authority to withdraw indictments related to the President's cases. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 이같이 밝혔다. 더불어민주당은 대통령 관련 사건의 공소 취소 권한을 특검에게 부여하는 내용의 ‘조작 기소 특검법’ 처리를 공언한 상태다.)

Regarding the handling of his own case, the President said, "At the very least, we need to uncover the truth," and noted, "There seem to be quite a few objectively problematic issues." He continued, "From my perspective, it would be much better to form a large-scale special investigation headquarters that I can direct, while from the opposition's standpoint, a neutral special counsel would be preferable. So, should we not do it? We can't just not do it." He added, "What method would be desirable—I think the National Assembly should consider and decide on that." (이 대통령은 자신의 사건 처리에 대해 “최소한 진상 규명은 해야 되겠다”며 “객관적으로 문제가 있어보이는 것들이 꽤 많다”고 했다. 이어 “내 입장에서는 내가 지휘할 수 있는 대규모 특별수사본부를 꾸려서 하는 게 훨씬 더 낫고, 야당 입장에서는 중립적인 특검이 하는 게 낫지 않나”라며 “그럼 하지 말아요? 안 할 수는 없죠”라고 했다. 그러면서 “어떤 방식이 바람직할까는 국회에서 고려해서 판단하면 될 것 같다”고 했다.)

The President stated, "Then what about the results? We'll decide after seeing the results," and "If it's wrong based on law and common sense, we correct it; if it's not wrong, we leave it as is. It's not that difficult." (이 대통령은 “그럼 그 결과는 어떻게 할 거냐? 결과를 보고 판단하면 되겠다”라며 “법과 상식에 따라서 잘못됐으면 시정하고, 잘못 안 됐으면 놔두면 된다. 별로 어렵지 않다”고 했다.)

Regarding follow-up legislation for prosecutorial reform, such as granting supplementary investigation authority to prosecutors at the Public Prosecution Office, the President said, "It's true that we need to limit authority to remove risks, but should the public suffer because of that?" (이 대통령은 공소청 검사에 대한 보완수사권 부여 여부 등 검찰개혁 후속 입법과 관련해선 “권한을 배제해서 위험성을 제거해야 되는 건 맞는데, 그것 때문에 국민이 피해를 보면 되겠나”라고 했다.)

He said, "As an extreme example, the statute of limitations is running out. The back-and-forth time becomes an issue, and I wonder—do we really need to completely block even the path of simply verifying basic facts that pose no risk of human rights violations? That's my thought, and it hasn't changed." He added, "But politics is also about reality," and "There are too many concerns among the public that this could be abused for wrongdoing." (그는 “극단적인 예로 공소시효가 다 돼 가는데. 왔다 갔다 하는 시간이 좀 문제가 되고 인권 침해의 위험성도 전혀 없는 단순 사실관계 확인하는 길까지 완전히 봉쇄해야 돼야 하는가 하는 게 제 생각”이라며 “지금도 그 생각은 변함이 없다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “정치는 또 현실”이라며 “그것도 악용해 나쁜 짓 하면 어떡하느냐는 걱정이 국민들 속에 너무 많다”고 했다.)

The President concluded, "Ultimately, it's a matter of decision," and said, "I think it might end up being handed over to the National Assembly, following their opinions." (이 대통령은 “결국은 결단의 문제”라며 “국회에 넘겨 그쪽의 의견을 따르는 쪽으로 정리하는 게 아닌가 싶다”고 했다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik Appoints Kang Tae-woong, Former Democratic Party Head of Yongsan District, as Chief of Staff (조정식 국회의장, 비서실장에 강태웅 전 민주당 용산지역위원장)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik Appoints Kang Tae-woong, Former Democratic Party Head of Yongsan District, as Chief of Staff (조정식 국회의장, 비서실장에 강태웅 전 민주당 용산지역위원장)

New National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik on the 8th appointed Kang Tae-woong, former head of the Democratic Party of Korea's Yongsan District chapter, as his chief of staff. The National Assembly Speaker's office announced that Speaker Woo completed the formation of his secretariat on this day, appointing a chief of staff and selecting four senior secretaries. (조정식 신임 국회의장이 8일 강태웅 전 더불어민주당 용산구 지역위원장을 비서실장에 임명했다. 국회의장실은 조 의장이 이날 비서실장을 임명하고, 수석비서관 4명을 선임하는 등 비서진 구성을 마무리했다고 밝혔다.)

Chief of Staff Kang Tae-woong has served in key positions including the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government's Planning and Coordination Office and as the First Vice Mayor for Administrative Affairs of Seoul. He joined the Democratic Party in 2020, ran in the 21st and 22nd general elections, and until recently served as the head of the Yongsan District chapter. He ran for the Yongsan District mayoral election in the June 3 local elections but was defeated by Kim Kyung-dae, the candidate from the People Power Party. The National Assembly Speaker's office explained, "Chief of Staff Kang has extensive experience in grassroots public welfare, political acumen, and a broad human network." <<> Lee Jung-hee, a former aide to Representative Woo Won-shik, was appointed as the new senior secretary for political affairs; Yoon Sang-eun, former deputy director of the floor leader's office, as senior secretary for policy; Lee Wang-hwi, former professor of political science and diplomacy at Ajou University, as senior secretary for foreign affairs and security; and Jang Hyun-joo, a lawyer, as senior secretary for public communication and media. <<> Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Lee served as a senior administrative officer at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae and as a central committee member of the Democratic Party of Korea. He has been assisting Speaker Woo since the 17th National Assembly. Senior Secretary for Policy Yoon, a former aide to Speaker Woo, has served as an administrative officer at Cheong Wa Dae and as deputy director of the floor leader's office. <<> Senior Secretary for Foreign Affairs and Security Lee, a specialist in international politics, contributed to planning foreign affairs, security, and unification policy tasks in the national planning committee of the Lee Jae-myung administration and served as an adviser to the National Economic Advisory Council. Senior Secretary for Public Communication and Media Jang Hyun-joo served as a deputy spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea and has held positions as an adjunct professor at the Graduate School of Education at Hanyang University and a non-standing director at the Korea Small Business Institute. (강태웅 비서실장은 서울시 기획조정실장 등 주요 보직을 거쳐 서울시 행정1부시장을 역임했다. 2020년 민주당에 입당해 21·22대 총선에 출마했고, 최근까지 용산구 지역위원장으로 활동해왔다. 6·3 지방선거에서 용산구청장 선거에 출마했지만 김경대 국민의힘 후보에 밀려 낙선했다. 국회의장실은 “강 비서실장은 민생 현장 경험과 정무적 감각, 인적 네트워크를 두루 갖췄다”고 설명했다.)

item.title: Factions Within People Power Party Argue for Allowing Re-elections Even If Election Results Are Unaffected (국민의힘 일각 “선거 결과 영향 없어도 재선거 가능하게 해야”)
item.description:
Factions Within People Power Party Argue for Allowing Re-elections Even If Election Results Are Unaffected (국민의힘 일각 “선거 결과 영향 없어도 재선거 가능하게 해야” )

Within the People Power Party, a forum was held condemning the issues surrounding the National Election Commission regarding the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections. At this forum, arguments were made that the Public Official Election Act should be amended to allow for re-elections even if the election results are unaffected, in cases where a serious fault by the Election Commission, like this incident, infringes on voting rights. (국민의힘 내에서 6·3 지방선거의 투표 용지 부족 사태를 두고 토론회를 열며 선거관리위원회의 문제점을 규탄했다. 이 자리에선 이번 사태 같은 선관위의 중대한 하자가 발생해 투표권이 침해됐을 경우엔 선거 결과에 영향이 없더라도 재선거를 할 수 있게 공직선거법을 개정해야 한다는 주장도 나왔다.)

On the 8th, the People Power Party held a forum hosted by the offices of lawmakers Na Kyung-won, Jo Bae-sook, Park Soo-young, Shin Dong-wook, Kwak Kyu-taek, Joo Jin-woo, Park Choong-kwon, and Yoon Yong-geun, along with the Policy Committee, under the theme "June 3 Ballot Paper Shortage and Election Malfeasance: The People Demand a Re-election and a Special Counsel." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk and former floor leader Song Eon-seok also attended. (국민의힘은 8일 나경원·조배숙·박수영·신동욱·곽규택·주진우·박충권·윤용근 의원실과 정책위원회 주최로 ‘6·3 투표 용지 부족·부실 선거 사태, 국민은 재선거·특검을 촉구한다’는 주제로 토론회를 가졌다. 여기엔 장동혁 대표와 송언석 전 원내대표도 참석했다.)

At the forum, lawmaker Na Kyung-won advocated for amending the election law. Lawmaker Na stated, "Even when examined legally, under the current Public Official Election Act and existing precedents, my conclusion is that a re-election is fundamentally difficult to hold in South Korea," adding, "Amending the election law to address the completeness of election procedures must take precedence." (나경원 의원은 이 자리에서 선거법 개정을 주장했다. 나 의원은 “법리적으로 따져봐도 현행 공직선거법과 기존 판례에 비춰보면 재선거는 원천적으로 대한민국에서 있기 어렵다는 것이 저의 결론”이라며 “선거 절차의 완전성 부분을 외면하는 선거법 개정이 먼저 수순”이라고 했다.)

Article 224 of the current Public Official Election Act stipulates that the Election Commission or the Supreme Court/High Court, upon receiving a petition or complaint, may only declare all or part of an election void or a candidate's election void in election disputes if it is determined that there was a violation of election-related regulations and that such a violation 'is deemed to have affected the election outcome.' Na viewed this provision as problematic. (현행 공직선거법 224조는 소청·소장을 접수한 선관위 또는 대법원·고등법원은 선거 쟁송에 있어 선거에 관한 규정에 위반된 사실이 있는 때라도 ‘선거의 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’에 한해 선거의 전부나 일부의 무효 또는 당선의 무효를 결정하거나 판결하게 돼 있다. 나 의원은 이 부분이 문제라고 봤다.)

Lawmaker Na argued, "The rule 'is deemed to have affected the election outcome' makes re-elections virtually impossible," and asserted, "Cases where voting is interrupted or effectively blocked should be defined as absolute grounds for invalidity, and for other serious procedural defects, the burden of proof should be placed on the Election Commission." She continued, "There is a question of whether amending the election law can be applied retroactively, but there is a Constitutional Court ruling that retroactive application is possible when a major constitutional interest is infringed. Therefore, we also intend to include a retroactive effect provision." (나 의원은 “‘선거의 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’라는 규정 때문에 재선거가 사실상 불가능한 구조”라며 “투표가 중단되거나 실질적으로 차단된 경우를 절대적 무효 사유로 규정하고, 기타 중대한 절차적 하자가 있을 경우 입증 책임을 선관위가 지도록 해야 한다”고 주장했다. 이어 “선거법을 개정한다고 해서 ‘과연 소급할 수 있느냐’는 문제가 있는데 중대한 헌법적 이익이 침해됐을 때는 소급할 수 있다는 헌법재판소의 결정이 있다”며 “따라서 소급효 규정 부분도 두려고 한다”고 했다.)

At the forum, there was widespread opinion that under the current election law, the possibility of a re-election due to this incident is low. However, there was a consensus on the need to establish legal grounds through future election law amendments to allow for re-elections when events like this occur. Lawmaker Jo Bae-sook stated, "What citizens are demanding is a re-election, but under current law, it is only possible after an election is confirmed void through litigation," and added, "We need to point out the problems in the current law and devise improvement measures." (이날 토론회에선 현행 선거법상 이번 사태로 인한 재선거 실시 가능성은 높지 않다는 의견이 많았다. 다만, 앞으로 선거법 개정을 통해 이번 사태 같은 일이 벌어질 때는 재선거를 할 수 있는 법적 근거를 마련해야 한다는 공감대는 형성됐다. 조배숙 의원은 “시민이 요구하는 것은 재선거지만 현행법상으로는 소송을 통해 선거 무효가 확정된 뒤에야 가능하다”며 “현행법의 문제점을 지적하고 개선 방안을 마련해야 한다”고 했다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "Fortunately, the Democratic Party has agreed to accept both a special counsel and a parliamentary investigation. I believe the order should be re-election, then special counsel, then parliamentary investigation. The issue that needs to be resolved most urgently is the re-election." Former floor leader Song Eon-seok stated, "A separate body is needed for job inspections and audits of the Election Commission," and added, "We should also consider establishing a new organization at the National Assembly level for the job inspections and audits of the Election Commission." (장동혁 대표는 “민주당에서 다행히 특검도, 국정조사도 수용하기로 했다”며 “저는 재선거, 특검, 국정조사 순서라고 생각한다. 가장 우선적으로 해결해야 할 문제가 재선거”라고 했다. 송언석 전 원내대표는 “선관위에 대한 직무 감찰과 감사를 위한 별도의 기관이 필요하다”며 “국회 차원에서 선관위의 직무 감찰과 감사를 위한 기구를 신설하는 것도 검토해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Intensifying calls for Jang Dong-hyuk to take responsibility for election defeat... Pro-leadership faction claims "Seoul election victory" (거센 장동혁 선거 패배 책임론... 당권파는 “서울 선거 승리”)
item.description:
Intensifying calls for Jang Dong-hyuk to take responsibility for election defeat... Pro-leadership faction claims "Seoul election victory" (거센 장동혁 선거 패배 책임론... 당권파는 “서울 선거 승리”)

As the People Power Party (PPP) lost 12 out of 16 regional government head elections on June 3 to the Democratic Party of Korea, calls for responsibility against party leader Jang Dong-hyuk have intensified daily. Senior and first-term lawmakers urged Representative Jang to clarify his stance on his position on the 8th. However, the pro-leadership faction supporting Representative Jang dismissed the responsibility argument again on the same day. (국민의힘이 6·3 광역단체장 선거 16곳 가운데 12곳을 더불어민주당에 내주면서 장동혁 대표에 대한 책임론이 연일 거세지고 있다. 당내 중진, 초선 의원 등은 8일 장 대표에게 거취 표명을 촉구했다. 하지만 장 대표를 지지하는 당권파는 이날도 장 대표 책임론을 일축했다.)

Jo Kyoung-tae, a six-term lawmaker and the most senior PPP member, said on MBC Radio that morning, "It was a complete defeat in the broader picture. The victory in the Seoul mayoral election or some other areas wasn't the PPP's win—it was the citizens' victory." He added, "Representative Jang said during the party leadership election that he would step down if the party lost in the local elections, so he should resign." This refers to when Representative Jang raised the 'O' panel during an O/X segment at the party convention in August last year, answering whether he would step down as party leader if the party lost the 2026 local elections. <<> Lawmaker Jo stated, "After Representative Jang resigns, the party should transition to an emergency committee system and hold an early national convention." He continued, "The shortage of ballot papers should not serve as a shield for responsibility for the election defeat," adding, "Whether under the newly elected floor leader or an emergency committee system, it's an area where struggle is possible. Why do you think Representative Jang himself should take the lead?" <<> Four-term lawmaker Kim Do-eup said on CBS Radio, "Typically, leadership that loses an election clarifies its stance on position. I believe Representative Jang will also make a wise decision." Lawmaker Kim Do-eup is running in the party's floor leader election scheduled for the 10th. Three lawmakers are running for the PPP's floor leader election, including Kim Do-eup, Jeong Jeom-sik, and Seong Il-jong. <<> First-term lawmaker Kim Jae-seop appeared on Channel A's YouTube channel on the same day, saying, "Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and former leader Han Dong-hoon, who distanced themselves from Representative Jang or took an anti-Jang line, have come back to life. It's failed leadership." He added, "Representative Jang must decide his position. There is no leader who ruins an election and claims a moral victory." <<> Four-term lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong, who won the by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-b district held alongside the June 3 local elections, responded to a host's question on KBS Radio about "the extent of Representative Jang's responsibility for the election results and what action should be taken," saying, "It is clear that when shifting the party's direction, discussions must include the issue of the leadership's position." Lawmaker Yoo added, "Candidates who directly campaigned in this election will know, but the atmosphere on the ground was truly poor. Everyone commonly acknowledges that our local election report card was not very good." <<> However, the pro-leadership faction refuted these arguments from within the party. PPP Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told reporters after that day's Supreme Council meeting, regarding Representative Jang's position, "As far as I know, no Supreme Council member has formally conveyed a stance on his position to Representative Jang." He said, "(In an interview before the elections) Representative Jang stated that his political life depended on the results of the Seoul and Busan mayoral elections, and he won the Seoul mayoral election. Whether this is seen as half a victory or half a failure is for the people and party members to judge." <<> Regarding the party's rising approval ratings, Senior Spokesperson Park stated, "The ballot paper incident had a decisive impact. We assess that the PPP leadership, which stayed on site through the day of the vote count, played a role in channeling this anger," adding, "The victory in the Seoul mayoral election also contributed to the rise in approval ratings." (국민의힘 최다선인 6선의 조경태 의원은 이날 오전 MBC 라디오에서 “큰 틀에서 완패했다. 서울시장 선거나 일부에서 승리한 건 국민의힘이 아니라 시민이 승리한 것”이라면서 “장 대표는 당대표 선거 때 지방선거에서 패배하면 물러나겠다고 했으니 사퇴해야 한다”고 말했다. 장 대표가 작년 8월 전당대회 TV토론에서 ‘내년(2026년) 지방선거에 패배하면 당대표직을 내려놓겠느냐’를 묻는 OX 코너에서 ‘O’ 패널을 든 것을 언급한 것이다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik: "Ballot Paper Shortage Incident to Be Subject to Prompt State Investigation" (조정식 국회의장 “투표용지 부족 사태, 지체 없이 국정조사 추진”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik: "Ballot Paper Shortage Incident to Be Subject to Prompt State Investigation" (조정식 국회의장 “투표용지 부족 사태, 지체 없이 국정조사 추진”)

National Assembly Speaker Cho Jeong-sik stated on the 8th regarding the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections, "We will promptly launch a state investigation at the National Assembly level to uncover the truth." (조정식 국회의장은 8일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 “지체 없이 국회 차원의 국정조사를 추진해 진상 규명에 나서도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Speaker Cho made this remark during a meeting with President Lee Jae-myung and the four key figures of the government (the National Assembly Speaker, the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, the President of the Constitutional Court, and the Prime Minister) at the presidential office, saying, "Many citizens are expressing concern and anger over the unprecedented ballot paper shortage." He also added, "The National Assembly will fulfill its duties, including preparing reform measures for the National Election Commission." The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party each submitted demands for a state investigation into the incident on the same day. (조 의장은 이날 청와대에서 열린 이재명 대통령과 4부 요인(국회의장, 대법원장, 헌법재판소장, 국무총리) 회동에서 “초유의 투표용지 부족 사태로 많은 국민께서 우려와 분노를 표하고 계신다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 “선관위 개혁 방안을 마련하는 등 국회가 해야 할 일을 하겠다”고도 했다. 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 이날 이번 사태에 대한 국정조사 요구안을 각각 제출했다.)

Speaker Cho stated, "As the head of the legislative branch, I view this incident very seriously and express strong regret over the fact that public trust in election administration, which is the manifestation of popular sovereignty and the foundation of procedural democracy, has been completely shaken." (조 의장은 “국민주권의 발현이자 절차적 민주주의의 근간인 선거 행정에 대한 국민의 신뢰가 송두리째 흔들리는 것에 대해서 입법부의 의장으로서도 이 사태를 매우 심각하게 보고 있으며, 강한 유감을 먼저 표한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Cho said, "This incident by the National Election Commission is a serious matter where an administrative convenience-oriented mindset has undermined the people's sacred right to vote, shaking trust in the national system—something that cannot be taken lightly." He added, "It is a situation where pursuing administrative convenience has ultimately damaged the essence of why the administration exists: the basic rights of the people." He further noted, "The moment a voter turns away due to a shortage of ballot papers, the procedural and institutional legitimacy of that election is damaged, regardless of the vote margin in the results." (조 의장은 “선관위의 이번 사태는 행정 편의주의적 발상이 국민의 신성한 참정권을 훼손해 국가 시스템에 대한 신뢰를 뒤흔든 중대 사태이며, 결코 가볍게 넘길 수 없는 일”이라며 “행정적 편의만을 추구하다 정작 행정이 존재해야 하는 본질인 국민의 기본권을 훼손시킨 사태”라고 했다. 이어 “투표용지가 모자라서 유권자가 발길을 돌리는 순간 그 선거의 결과가 몇 표의 차이든 간에 상관없이 절차적 그리고 제도적 정당성을 훼손시킨 것”이라고 했다.)

He stated, "This incident is by no means a matter of factionalism or ideology," adding, "The conspiracy theories raised by some are also untrue, and they do not help in resolving this incident or in the national interest." (그는 “이번 사태는 진영의 문제나 이념의 문제가 결코 아니다”라며 “일각에서 제기되는 음모론도 사실이 아니며, 이것은 이번 사태의 수습과 국익에 결코 도움이 되지 않는다”고 했다.)

He further said, "Self-reflection and thorough, fundamental improvement measures are needed for the situation caused by unchecked independence," adding, "The Constitution grants independence to the National Election Commission to ensure political neutrality, but as the Commission has gone without oversight and checks for a long time, it has increasingly become a closed organization insensitive to any external scrutiny, criticism, or warnings. There have also been shocking incidents such as hiring irregularities or the so-called 'basket voting' in the past." (그러면서 “견제받지 않은 독립성이 초래한 사태에 대해 자성과 철저한 근본적인 개선 대책이 필요하다”며 “헌법이 선관위에 독립성을 부여한 것은 정치적 중립을 지키라는 의미인데, 선관위가 감시와 견제를 받지 않은 시간이 오래되면서 선관위에 대한 외부의 어떤 시선이나 비판 또는 경고에 둔감한 닫힌 조직이 이미 돼가고 있고, 그간 채용 비리 또는 ‘소쿠리 투표’와 같은 충격적 사건들도 발생한 바가 있다”고 했다.)

Speaker Cho concluded, "I believe this incident reveals in stark detail how complacent the approach to the people's right to vote can become under the shadow of constitutional independence." (조 의장은 “이번 일은 헌법적 독립성이란 그늘 아래서 국민의 참정권을 대하는 태도가 얼마나 안일해질 수 있는가를 적나라하게 드러낸 것이라고 본다”고 했다.)

item.title: Opposition Says President Lee's First Anniversary Press Conference "Makes Citizens' Hearts Crushed" and "Highlights Out-of-Body Speech Style" (野, 李대통령 1주년 회견에 “국민 억장 무너져” “유체 이탈 화법”)
item.description:
Opposition Says President Lee's First Anniversary Press Conference "Makes Citizens' Hearts Crushed" and "Highlights Out-of-Body Speech Style" (野, 李대통령 1주년 회견에 “국민 억장 무너져” “유체 이탈 화법”)

On the 8th, the opposition heavily criticized President Lee Jae-myung's first anniversary press conference, calling it "heartbreaking for the public" and "the pinnacle of out-of-body speech." (야권은 8일 이재명 대통령의 취임 1주년 기자회견에 대해 “국민 억장이 무너지는 소리”, “유체 이탈 화법의 극치”라면서 거세게 비판했다.)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a press conference at the National Assembly shortly after President Lee's event, stating, "Thinking about what lies ahead makes me feel bleak. I've once again realized that there is a separate 'Lee Jae-myung universe.'" Jang added, "In today's press conference, I couldn't find even a hint of remorse for the people suffering in a real estate nightmare. He stubbornly claimed it was 'normalization, not a surge,' and bragged about increasing property taxes, saying Seoul home prices were well-controlled. This is heartbreaking for the people." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이 대통령 기자회견 직후인 이날 오후 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “앞으로 벌어질 일을 생각하면 눈앞이 캄캄해진다. ‘이재명 유니버스’가 따로 있다는 사실을 다시 한번 실감했다”고 말했다. 장 대표는 “오늘 회견에서는 부동산 지옥으로 고통받는 국민들에 대한 일말의 미안함도 찾아볼 수 없었다. ‘대폭등이 아니라 정상화’라는 억지를 부렸다. 서울 집값 잘 막았다며 보유세 인상을 들먹였다”며 “국민들 억장이 무너지는 소리”라고 했다.)

Regarding President Lee's reaffirmation of his intention to pursue a 'dismissal special counsel' for his own case, Jang said, "The election is over, so it's effectively a declaration of dictatorship, implying 'Now I'll do whatever I want.' If he truly wants to strongly push for normalization of the abnormal, as he claims, the first thing he should do is resume his own trial." Earlier, at the press conference, President Lee had said about the dismissal of his case, "We just need to follow the law and common sense. If it's wrong, dismiss it; if it's not wrong, leave it as is." (장 대표는 이 대통령이 ‘공소 취소 특검’ 추진 의사를 재확인 것에 대해 “선거도 끝났으니 ‘이제 하고 싶은 대로 다 하겠다’는 사실상의 독재 선언”이라며 “본인 말대로 비정상의 정상화를 강력하게 추진하려면 가장 먼저 해야 할 일은 이재명 본인의 재판 재개”라고 했다. 앞서 이 대통령은 이날 기자회견에서 자신의 사건에 대한 공소 취소와 관련해 “법과 상식대로 하면 된다”며 “잘못됐으면 취소하고, 잘못 안 됐으면 놔두는 것”이라고 했다.)

Additionally, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the PPP, stated, "President Lee clearly expressed his intention to dismiss his own case. He framed it as following law and common sense, but there is nothing more against law and common sense than Lee Jae-myung dismissing Lee Jae-myung's own case. If he dismisses his case, I will push for impeachment." (또한 국민의힘에서 제명된 무소속 한동훈 의원은 “이 대통령이 자기 사건 공소 취소하고 싶다는 뜻을 분명히 했다. 법과 상식에 따라 한다는 식으로 말했는데, 이재명이 이재명 공소 취소하는 것만큼 법과 상식에 안 맞는 짓은 없다”며 “자기 사건 공소 취소하면 탄핵에 나설 것”이라고 했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon commented in a statement, "It's a comprehensive display of self-praise and blame-shifting, with no trace of painful reflection, responsibility, or solutions for the failures of the past year." (국민의힘 박성훈 수석대변인은 논평에서 “지난 1년간의 실정에 대한 처절한 성찰도, 책임도, 해법도 찾아볼 수 없는 자화자찬과 남 탓의 종합판”이라고 했다.)

Regarding President Lee's remark at the press conference that the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections was "absurd," five-term PPP lawmaker Na Kyung-won wrote on Facebook, "This is the height of out-of-body speech. How can he talk about it as if it's someone else's issue? The president should directly apologize and express regret to the people." (이 대통령이 이날 기자회견에서 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 “어처구니없는 일”이라고 말한 것을 두고, 5선의 국민의힘 나경원 의원은 페이스북에서 “유체 이탈 화법의 극치다. 어떻게 이렇게 남이 얘기하듯 할 수 있나”라며 “대통령이 국민 앞에 직접 사과하고 유감을 표시해야 마땅하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Effectively Rejects Resignation... "Look at the Objective Data of the Election Results" (장동혁, 사실상 사퇴 거부... “선거 결과, 객관적 데이터 보라”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk Effectively Rejects Resignation... "Look at the Objective Data of the Election Results" (장동혁, 사실상 사퇴 거부... “선거 결과, 객관적 데이터 보라”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on the 8th dismissed the blame for the defeat in the June 3 local elections being raised inside and outside the party, effectively rejecting demands for his resignation. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 8일 당 안팎에서 거론되는 6·3 지방선거 패배 책임론을 일축하고, 사실상 사퇴 요구를 거부했다.)

Leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a press conference at the National Assembly that afternoon criticizing President Lee Jae-myung's first-anniversary press conference. At the end of the press conference, Jang faced a reporter's question: "Many lawmakers say the party leader should state his position on the election results. What is your view?" <<> In response, Jang briefly replied, "Let me ask you this: How do you evaluate the results of this local election based on objective data?" before leaving the press conference venue. <<> This appears to be his rebuttal that, although the People Power Party lost 12 of the 16 metropolitan government head positions in the June 3 elections to the Democratic Party of Korea, it achieved certain gains in the 14 by-elections, securing three constituencies—Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, Ulsan Nam-gap, and Chungnam Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang—that were previously Democratic Party strongholds. <<> This has been interpreted as Jang effectively rejecting calls for his resignation. In a Facebook post on the 4th, immediately after the elections, Jang also said, "I am sorry for the disappointing election results," but added, "Although this election was difficult in every way, we managed to keep the flame of hope alive." <<> However, within the party, calls for Jang to clarify his position continued on this day. Cho Kyung-tae, a six-term lawmaker and the most senior member of the People Power Party, said on MBC Radio that morning, "We suffered a comprehensive defeat. The victories in the Seoul mayoral election and some other races were not wins for the People Power Party, but for the citizens." He added, "Jang should step down, and the party should transition to an emergency committee system and hold an early national convention." Four-term lawmaker Kim Do-eup said on CBS Radio, "Typically, leadership that loses an election states its position. I believe Leader Jang will also make a wise decision." <<> First-term lawmaker Kim Jae-seop also appeared on Channel A's YouTube channel that day, saying, "Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and former leader Han Dong-hoon, who kept their distance from Leader Jang or took an anti-Jang route, have come back to life. Jang has failed leadership." He added, "Jang must decide his position. There is no leader who ruins an election and then cheers themselves up with a moral victory." Yoo Eui-dong, a four-term lawmaker who won the by-election in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul held concurrently with the June 3 local elections, responded on KBS Radio to the host's question, "To what extent is Leader Jang responsible for the election results, and what should be done?" by saying, "It is clear that the direction of the party should be discussed, including the issue of the leadership's position." (장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 이재명 대통령의 취임 1주년 기자회견을 비판하는 기자회견을 열었다. 장 대표는 기자회견 말미에 ‘많은 의원들이 지방선거 결과에 따른 대표가 거취 표명을 해야 한다고 하는데 어떻게 생각하느냐’라는 기자 질의를 받았다.)

item.title: Lee: "NEC’s Problems Serious"... Four Branches Also Call for "Truth Investigation" (李 “선관위 문제 심각”... 4부 요인도 “진상 규명”)
item.description:
Lee: "NEC’s Problems Serious"... Four Branches Also Call for "Truth Investigation" (李 “선관위 문제 심각”... 4부 요인도 “진상 규명”)

President Lee Jae-myung and the leaders of South Korea’s four branches of government (the heads of the legislature, judiciary, executive, and Constitutional Court) held an emergency meeting at the presidential office in Yongsan on the afternoon of the 8th, defining the "shortage of ballot papers" that occurred during the June 3 local elections as a serious infringement on the right to vote and a crisis in the constitutional order. They agreed to pursue a thorough investigation of the truth, along with strict accountability based on the results of the investigation and a parliamentary inquiry, as well as a fundamental overhaul of the election management system. <<> At the meeting held at the presidential office, President Lee pointed out, "Regardless of the number involved or whether it affected the outcome, failing to guarantee the exercise of voting rights and the full realization of popular sovereignty is an extremely serious issue for which there is no excuse, even with ten mouths to speak." The meeting was attended by President Lee, along with National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, Constitutional Court Chief Justice Kim Sang-hwan, and Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, excluding the chairperson of the National Election Commission from the previous five-branch leadership. <<> President Lee said, "Today, the heads of independent constitutional institutions have gathered. I hope we can first have an official discussion on how to handle this issue. While no clear method may emerge, it is necessary first to clarify the truth." He added, "We must take appropriate responsibility from the public’s perspective in some form, and we should also discuss possible alternatives and countermeasures together." <<> On this day, the leaders of the four branches also expressed concern over the ballot shortage that caused the infringement on voting rights and spoke with one voice about the need for a truth investigation and institutional improvements. National Assembly Speaker Cho said, "Self-reflection on the situation caused by unchecked independence and thorough, fundamental improvement measures are needed. This starkly reveals how complacent the attitude toward the people’s voting rights can become under the shadow of constitutional independence." He added, "We will promptly push for a parliamentary inquiry at the National Assembly level to uncover the truth and prepare reform plans for the NEC. This time, a definite remedy and fundamental improvement measures must be put in place." <<> Chief Justice Kim said, "I take this situation seriously, thinking that it may have damaged the public’s trust and pride in South Korea’s democracy and electoral system. Although we have faced unexpected difficulties and trial and error, we have always turned these into lessons to build a more mature and stable democracy." He added, "We should use this incident as a painful opportunity to rigorously ascertain the truth of the matter and conduct a legal evaluation, while also coldly reviewing and improving the election system and its operations." <<> Prime Minister Kim said, "This should be a place where those responsible for the state, government, and constitutional institutions first make a joint declaration of their will to take responsibility and resolve this issue for the people." He added, "The National Assembly has set a direction to conduct a parliamentary inquiry, and I mentioned yesterday that the government should organize a body that includes the ruling and opposition parties and the people. Furthermore, we must share a resolve to solve the problems raised by the people, even by amending laws or, if necessary, the Constitution." <<> After the meeting, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Gyu-yeon briefed the media on the closed-door meeting between President Lee and the leaders of the four branches. According to Senior Secretary Lee, the meeting delved deeply into governance reform plans to fix the administrative failures that occurred as the NEC hid behind the shield of independence. Specifically, the issue of making the chairperson of the National Election Commission and local election commission chairs full-time, instead of part-time, was discussed. This arose from criticisms that, under the current structure where a Supreme Court justice concurrently serves as the NEC chair and a district court chief serves as a local election commission chair, the command center was paralyzed when signs of ballot depletion appeared at 2 PM on election day. <<> The attendees agreed on the need for a structure where chairs work full-time and take responsibility for election administration, and the presidential office reported that the details of the reform plan would be coordinated through the National Assembly’s parliamentary inquiry and legislative process. <<> However, the presidential office drew a line on the possibility of constitutional amendments to adjust the NEC’s status, as raised by some quarters. In response to a related question, Senior Secretary Lee said, "There was no mention of constitutional amendments at all in the closed-door meeting. Since constitutional amendments are not easy to achieve, the discussions proceeded within the framework of general legislative supplementation and institutional improvement." (이재명 대통령과 대한민국 4부 요인(입법·사법·행정·헌법재판소 수장)은 8일 오후 청와대에서 긴급 회동을 갖고, 지난 6·3 지방선거 과정에서 발생한 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’를 중대한 참정권 침해이자 헌정 질서의 위기로 규정했다. 이들은 철저한 진상 규명과 함께 수사 및 국정조사 결과에 따른 엄중한 문책, 그리고 선거 관리 체계의 근본적인 대개혁을 추진하기로 뜻을 모았다.)
