item.title: Lee: "Civil servants suffer because of Han Sung-sook... I hope other civil servants feel it too" (李 “한성숙 때문에 공무원 괴로워... 다른 공무원들도 느껴보길”)
item.description:
Lee: "Civil servants suffer because of Han Sung-sook... I hope other civil servants feel it too" (李 “한성숙 때문에 공무원 괴로워... 다른 공무원들도 느껴보길”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung said at a press conference marking his first anniversary in office held at the Blue House on the 8th, regarding the nomination of Minister of SMEs and Startups Han Sung-sook as the new prime ministerial candidate the previous day (the 7th), "The selection process involved considerable thought, but in the end, I chose someone who would work, just someone to get the job done." He noted that while there were concerns about the lack of political weight in nominating a candidate who is not a career politician, he opted for "someone who works." ()

President Lee stated, "The political aspects will be well-handled by the party," adding, "We aim to have our cabinet sprint with all its strength in the given environment." He continued, "I judged that Minister Han is the right person for that." (이재명 대통령은 8일 청와대에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 전날(7일) 한성숙 중소벤처기업부 장관을 신임 국무총리 후보자로 지명한 것과 관련해 “선택하는 과정이 꽤 고민이 적지는 않았는데, 결론은 일할 사람으로, 그냥 일만 할 사람으로 했다”고 말했다. 정치인 출신이 아닌 한 후보자를 지명하면서 정치적 무게감이 덜해 고민이 있었지만 ‘일할 사람’을 선택했다는 것이다.)

President Lee remarked, "(Candidate Han) works very hard and does a great job," noting, "Civil servants say she's a bit tough." He added, "They complain because she piles on so much work," and said, "I want other civil servants to feel that hardship too." Laughter broke out among the journalists attending the press conference at the president's comment. (이 대통령은 “정치적 요소는 당이 잘 해결해줄 것”이라며 “우리 내각은 정말 주어진 환경 속에서 있는 힘을 다해 전력 질주할 수 있도록 하려고 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “그렇게 하기에는 한 장관이 적격이라는 판단이 들었다”고 했다.)

President Lee's first anniversary press conference ran from 10 a.m. that day for 166 minutes. Originally scheduled for 100 minutes, the president took additional questions for 66 minutes. (이 대통령은 “(한 후보자가) 정말 열심히 하시고 잘하신다”며 “공무원들이 좀 괴롭다고 한다”고 했다. 이어 “공무원들이 너무 (일을) 많이 시켜서 괴로워한다”며 “그 괴로움을 다른 공무원들도 좀 느끼게 해주고 싶다”고 했다. 이 대통령의 언급에 기자회견에 참석한 기자들 사이에서 웃음이 터졌다.)

During the press conference, there were moments of laughter at the president's jocular remarks. When asked about his assessment of the local election results, President Lee said, "I'm supposed to stay neutral in political elections, but I couldn't quite stay neutral on the outcome." This suggested he found it hard to accept that while the Democratic Party won 12 out of 16 metropolitan and provincial governor seats, it lost in four areas, including Seoul. President Lee said, "I felt I need to work a bit harder," adding, "For two or three days, my condition, my state wasn't very good." (이 대통령의 취임 1주년 기자회견은 이날 오전 10시부터 166분간 진행됐다. 당초 100분으로 예정됐는데, 이 대통령이 66분 동안 질문을 더 받았다.)

President Lee also directly selected journalists to ask questions that day. At one point, he pointed to a reporter sitting in front, and when the reporter identified themselves as belonging to a newspaper from the Daegu-Gyeongbuk region, the president laughed, saying, "Of all places, I picked that one." This was interpreted as meaning he had inadvertently chosen a reporter from a region that doesn't typically vote for the Democratic Party. (기자회견 중간 중간, 이 대통령의 농담 섞인 언급에 웃음이 터지기도 했다. 이 대통령은 지방선거 결과에 대한 평가를 묻는 질문에 “원래 정치 선거에서 중립해야 되는데, (선거 결과에) 중립이 잘 안 되더라”고 했다. 더불어민주당이 16개 시·도지사 중 12곳을 이겼지만, 서울을 포함한 4곳에서 패배한 것을 받아들이기 어려웠다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 “조금 더 열심히 해야 되겠다는 생각이 들었다”며 “하여튼 2~3일은 저도 상황이, 상태가 그렇게 좋지 않았다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Samsung Electronics union's strike, President Lee said, "In the past, what we imagined was, since the company has a lot of profits, we'd say things like 'We need to raise wages, let's increase them by 15%, 20%,'" adding, "But (the Samsung Electronics union) proposed sharing the operating profit. Isn't that quite lively?" (이 대통령은 이날 질문할 기자를 직접 지목하기도 했다. 한 번은 앞에 앉은 기자를 지목했는데, 해당 기자가 대구·경북 지역 신문 소속임을 밝히자 “하필이면 거기를 찍었다”며 웃음을 보이기도 했다. 하필 민주당에 표를 잘 주지 않는 지역 기자를 선정했다는 의미로 해석됐다.)

item.title: Election Commission: "91 Locations Suffered Ballot Shortages"... 41 More Than Announced Three Days Ago (선관위 “투표용지 부족 91곳”... 사흘 전 발표때보다 41곳 늘어)
item.description:
Election Commission: "91 Locations Suffered Ballot Shortages"... 41 More Than Announced Three Days Ago (선관위 “투표용지 부족 91곳”... 사흘 전 발표때보다 41곳 늘어)

The National Election Commission (NEC) stated on the 8th that during the main voting day of the June 3 local elections, there were 91 polling stations nationwide that experienced ballot shortages. This marks an increase of 41 from the 50 locations announced on the 5th. (중앙선거관리위원회(선관위)가 8일 6·3 지방선거 본투표일에 투표용지가 부족했던 투표소가 전국 91곳이었다고 밝혔다. 지난 5일 발표한 50곳에서 41곳 늘어난 것이다.)

The NEC also reported that 140 polling stations were provided with additional ballots due to anticipated shortages. Among them, shortages actually occurred at 91 stations, including 42 in Seoul, 23 in Gyeonggi, 11 in Incheon, 4 in Daegu, 3 in Busan, 2 each in Ulsan, South Jeolla, and South Gyeongsang, and 1 each in North Chungcheong and North Jeolla. (선관위는 이날 투표용지 부족이 예상돼 추가 배부된 투표소는 140곳이었다고 밝혔다. 그중 실제로 투표용지 부족이 발생한 곳은 91곳으로 서울 42곳, 경기 23곳, 인천 11곳, 대구 4곳, 부산 3곳, 울산·전남·경남 2곳, 충북·전북 1곳 등이었다.)

The number of polling stations where voting was suspended and then resumed also increased from 22 announced on the 5th to 26. These included 22 stations in Seoul, such as 15 in Songpa District, 4 in Gangnam District, 2 in Gwangjin District, and 1 in Seocho District, as well as 1 each in Busan's Buk District, Daegu's Dong District, Incheon's Yeonsu District, and Gyeonggi's Gimpo. (투표가 중지됐다가 재개한 투표소도 지난 5일 발표한 22곳에서 26곳으로 늘었다. 서울 송파구 15곳, 강남구 4곳, 광진구 2곳, 서초구 1곳 등 서울이 22곳이었고, 부산 북구·대구 동구·인천 연수구·경기 김포(이상 1곳) 등이었다.)

According to data submitted by the NEC to lawmaker Kim Min-jeon of the People Power Party, the total number of ballots that ran short nationwide on election day was 4,726. This figure was tallied based on 50 locations nationwide, and it is expected to increase when recalculated based on the 91 locations. (선관위가 이날 국민의힘 김민전 의원에게 제출한 자료에 따르면, 선거 당일 전국에서 부족했던 투표용지 수는 총 4726장이었다. 이 수치는 전국 50곳을 기준으로 집계한 것으로, 91곳 기준으로 집계하면 더 늘어날 전망이다.)

Additionally, at a polling station in Cheongju, North Chungcheong, it was confirmed that voting was delayed after the names of over 1,000 voters were omitted during the printing of the voter list. Voting resumed after about 30 minutes following a reprint, but it was reported that some voters whose names were missing gave up on casting their ballots. Kim Young-hwan, the People Power Party candidate for governor of North Chungcheong who lost in this election, stated, "I cannot accept an election where the right to vote was undermined." (또 충북 청주의 한 투표소에선 선거인 명부 출력 과정에서 유권자 1000여 명의 이름이 누락돼 투표가 지연된 것으로 확인됐다. 재출력하느라 약 30분 만에 투표가 재개됐는데, 이름이 누락돼 있던 유권자 일부는 투표를 포기한 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 선거에서 낙선한 김영환 국민의힘 충북지사는 “참정권이 훼손된 이번 선거에 결코 승복할 수 없다”고 했다.)

The NEC announced that it will operate a fact-finding committee consisting of six external members recommended by civic groups, the legal community, media, and academia, from the 10th to the 19th. Attorney Jo Hyun-wook will serve as the committee chair. (선관위는 시민단체·법조계·언론계·학계로부터 추천받은 외부 인사 총 6명으로 구성된 진상규명위원회를 오는 10일부터 19일까지 운영한다고 밝혔다. 위원장은 조현욱 변호사가 맡는다.)

Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de accepted the resignation of NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak, who stepped down taking responsibility for this incident, on the same day. The NEC stated that Standing Commissioner Wi Cheol-hwan, a classmate of President Lee Jae-myung from the Judicial Research and Training Institute's 18th class, will act as the acting chairperson. (조희대 대법원장은 이번 사태에 책임을 지고 사퇴한 노태악 중앙선관위원장의 사의를 이날 수용했다. 중앙선관위는 이재명 대통령의 사법연수원 18기 동기인 위철환 상임위원이 위원장 직무를 대행한다고 밝혔다.)

In relation to the ballot shortage incident, both the ruling and opposition parties submitted separate requests for a parliamentary investigation as their official party lines. National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik stated, "We will promptly pursue a parliamentary investigation at the National Assembly level." Democratic Party lawmaker Baek Hye-ryun and People Power Party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye each proposed special counsel bills to investigate the incident. (여야는 이날 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 각자 국정조사 요구서를 당론으로 제출했다. 조정식 국회의장은 “지체 없이 국회 차원의 국정조사를 추진하겠다”고 했다. 백혜련 민주당 의원, 김은혜 국민의힘 의원은 각각 이번 사태를 수사하기 위한 특검법을 발의했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “North Korea Still Producing Nuclear Materials… The Goal is to Halt It for Now” (李대통령 “北, 지금도 핵물질 생산중… 일단 중단시키는 게 목표”)
item.description:
During a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the North Korean nuclear issue, “In the long term, we must definitely move toward denuclearization,” but added, “For now, I believe we should set short-term goals for negotiations: halting the additional production of nuclear materials, imposing a moratorium on the export of nuclear materials, and stopping the development of ICBM (Intercontinental Ballistic Missile) technology.” President Lee also mentioned, “I have conveyed this to U.S. President Donald Trump on multiple occasions.” (이재명 대통령이 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 북핵 문제와 관련해 “장기적으로는 반드시 비핵화를 향해 가야 한다”면서도 “지금은 핵물질 추가 생산 중단, 핵물질 해외 반출 안 하기(모라토리엄), ICBM(대륙간탄도미사일) 기술 개발 중단만 단기 목표로 잡고 협상해야 한다고 본다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “이 얘기를 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게도 여러 차례 드렸다”고 했다.)

President Lee noted that while sanctions are being applied to pressure North Korea, “It’s unclear whether China’s door is truly closed, but Russia’s door is definitely open.” He further stated that North Korea is circumventing sanctions and “producing nuclear materials capable of making 10 to 20 nuclear weapons per year, even at this moment,” adding that “ICBM technology continues to improve and has nearly reached its final stage.” Regarding the theory of South Korea arming itself with nuclear weapons to counter North Korea, President Lee called it “truly irresponsible talk” and commented, “If we go nuclear, would Japan and Taiwan stay put? Everyone would go nuclear, turning the entire region into a nuclear wasteland, which is not desirable.” (이 대통령은 대북 제재로 북한을 압박하고 있지만 “중국 쪽 문이 확실히 닫혔는지 알 수 없고 러시아 쪽 문은 확실히 열려 있다”고 했다. 또 북한이 대북 제재를 우회하며 “지금 이 순간에도 1년에 10∼20개의 핵무기를 만들 수 있는 핵 물질을 생산하고 있다”며 “ICBM 기술도 계속 성능을 개선해 거의 마지막 지점”에 이른 것으로 평가했다. 이 대통령은 북핵에 대응한 한국의 핵무장론에 대해서는 “정말 무책임한 소리”라며 “핵무장을 하면 일본, 대만은 가만히 있겠나. 다 핵무장해서 온 동네가 핵천지가 되는데 바람직하지 않다”고 했다.)

Addressing the severed inter-Korean dialogue, President Lee said, “It’s claimed that (the Yoon Suk Yeol government) tried to provoke military clashes to justify martial law, but how much humiliation must (North Korea) have endured to withstand that?” He added, “We did indeed aggravate North Korea in certain ways.” While citing the ‘drone infiltration into Pyongyang’ during the Yoon administration as an example, he did not mention North Korea’s prior drone infiltrations and other provocations against the South. (이 대통령은 남북 대화 단절 상황에 대해 “(윤석열 정부가) 계엄 명분으로 삼으려고 군사 충돌을 유도했다고 하는데 (북한이) 그것을 견뎌내면서 얼마나 모멸감을 느꼈겠나”라고 했다. 또 “우리가 북한을 막 어떻게 집적거려서 문제가 되기는 했다”고 말했다. 윤석열 정부 당시 ‘평양 무인기 침투’를 예로 들면서도, 북한이 먼저 시작한 무인기 침투 등 대남 도발은 언급하지 않았다.)

Referring to Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to North Korea on the same day, President Lee emphasized, “As neighboring countries, we must respect each other with China and maintain necessary communication. We also need to manage relations, and the same goes for Russia.” He noted that while North Korea-China and North Korea-Russia ties are tightening, such as Xi’s visit to the North, inter-Korean relations are seeing “borders growing larger, with boundary lines turning from dashed to solid lines, and solid lines now becoming barriers, but we must continuously engage in dialogue.” (이 대통령은 시진핑 중국 국가주석이 이날 북한을 방문한 것을 거론하면서 “중국과의 관계도 우리가 인접해 있는 국가로서 서로 존중하고 또 필요한 소통을 해야 하겠다. 또 관리해야 되고 러시아도 마찬가지”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 시 주석 북한 방문 등 북·중, 북·러 관계가 밀착하는 반면 남북 관계는 “경계가 더 커지고, 경계선이 점선이 실선이 되고 실선이 이제는 장벽이 되기는 하지만 끊임없이 대화해야 된다”고 했다.)

President Lee remarked that the South Korean stock market had been excessively undervalued, saying, “If it were due to risks of war, or instability in diplomatic, military, and security areas, then Taiwan cannot be explained.” This is interpreted as meaning that Taiwan’s stock market, despite facing threats from China, has shown strength, so the undervaluation of the South Korean market cannot solely be attributed to the ‘North Korean risk.’ (이 대통령은 우리 주식시장이 과도하게 눌려 있었다며 “전쟁 위험성, 외교·군사·안보적 영역의 불안정 때문이라면 대만을 설명할 수가 없다”고 했다. 중국 위협을 받는 대만 주식 시장이 강세를 보이는 상황에서 우리 주식 시장이 저평가됐던 것을 ‘북한 리스크’로만 해석할 수 없다는 뜻으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: "At 7:16 a.m. on the 4th, Seoul's destiny shifted... Will the People Power Party head into the rough seas of the center, or become a 'YouTube party' trapped by hardline supporters?" (“4일 7시16분 서울 운명 바뀌어… 국힘, 거친 중도 바다로 갈건가, 강성층 갇힌 유튜브당 될건가”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party (PPP) Mayor of Seoul, reached the milestone of a fifth term as mayor through the June 3 local elections. In an interview with this newspaper on the 8th, after barely turning the tide in the election, which he fought without support from the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, Mayor Oh stated, "The message the public sent to the PPP was clear," adding, "It's telling us to advance into the rough seas of the center." He also noted, "We must no longer degenerate into a 'YouTube party' that only scratches where the hardline support base itches." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장은 이번 6·3 지방선거를 통해 ‘서울시장 5선’ 고지에 올랐다. ‘장동혁 지도부’ 지원을 거부하고 치른 선거전에서 가까스로 역전한 오 시장은 8일 본지 인터뷰에서 “국민이 국민의힘에 보낸 메시지는 명확했다”면서 “이제 중도의 거친 바다로 나아가라는 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “더 이상 강성 지지층 가려운 곳만 긁어주는 ‘유튜브 정당’으로 전락해선 안 된다”고도 했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission's "shortage of ballot papers" incident, Mayor Oh said, "We must mobilize all strong measures to uncover the truth until voters are convinced." On the calls for a "re-election," he explained, "Under election law, a re-election cannot be held unless there is an illegality that could change the outcome," adding, "Wouldn't the court provide a judgment in the expected election lawsuit?" (오 시장은 선관위의 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’에 대해 “모든 강력한 수단을 동원해 유권자가 납득할 때까지 진상 규명을 해야 한다”고 했다. ‘재선거’ 주장에 대해선 “선거법에는 당락이 바뀔 위법이 아니라면 재선거는 치를 수 없게 돼 있다”며 “예상되는 선거 소송에서 법원 판단이 나오지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

During the interview, Mayor Oh remarked, "At 7:16 a.m. (on the 4th), the moment the vote share turned around, a wave of relief washed over me, thinking, 'Ah, now Seoul is saved.'" Mayor Oh, who beat Democratic Party candidate Han Myeong-sook by a 0.6 percentage point margin in 2010, this time staged a 1.15 percentage point victory over Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh. Political circles predict that Mayor Oh's future path four years from now will be aligned with the "2030 presidential election." (인터뷰 중간, 오 시장은 “(4일) 아침 7시 16분 득표율이 역전하는 순간, ‘아, 이제 서울이 살았구나’ 하는 안도가 밀려왔다”고 했다. 2010년 한명숙 민주당 후보를 0.6%포인트 차로 이겼던 오 시장은 이번에 정원오 민주당 후보를 상대로 1.15%포인트 차 승부를 연출했다. 정치권에서는 4년 뒤 오 시장의 진로가 ’2030년 대선’에 맞춰질 것이란 전망이 나온다.)

－How do you evaluate the local election results? (－지방선거 결과를 평가하면.)

"It means the line advocated by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk has failed. The PPP now stands at a crossroads: whether to advance into the rough seas of the center or degenerate into a 'YouTube party' that only scratches where the hardline support base itches. It's time for PPP lawmakers to decide whether to contest the next general election under the current line." (“장동혁 대표가 지향하는 노선이 실패했다는 의미다. 지금 국민의힘은 중도의 거친 바다로 나아가느냐, 아니면 강성 지지층의 가려운 곳만 긁어주는 ‘유튜브 정당’으로 전락하느냐 기로에 섰다. 이제는 국민의힘 의원들도 지금의 노선으로 내후년 총선을 치를 것인지 결단해야 할 시점이다.”)

－What changes are needed? (－어떤 변화가 필요한가.)

"In this election, we barely won the Daegu mayoral election—a 'conservative stronghold'—by an 8.8 percentage point margin. We must soberly assess the current crisis. At the Seoul Metropolitan Area Daegu-Gyeongbuk Association meeting in December 2024, I said, 'The one who wins elections and brings back power is the true filial son of conservatism.' The audience stirred. Do conservatives now need politicians who fight fiercely in the National Assembly but lose elections? A party is competent only when it wins elections. If we don't establish centrist, expansive, and practical values as the party line, our party will continue to wander in a maze." (“이번 선거에서 우리는 ‘보수 텃밭’이라는 대구시장 선거에서 8.8%포인트 격차로 간신히 이겼다. 현재의 위기를 냉정하게 바라보아야 한다. 2024년 12월 재경 대구·경북 향우회에 참석해서 ‘선거에 이겨서 정권을 가져오는 사람이 보수의 진짜 효자다’라고 했다. 좌중이 웅성거리더라. 국회에서 거칠게 싸우다가 정작 선거에서는 지는 정치인이 지금 보수에 필요한가. 선거에서 이겨야 비로소 유능한 정당이다. 중도 확장적인 실용 가치를 정당 노선으로 세우지 않는다면, 우리 당은 앞으로도 계속 미로 속에서 헤맬 수밖에 없다.”)

－Calls for Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation are growing. (－장동혁 대표 사퇴론이 커지는데.)

"Whether Representative Jang holds onto the leadership to the end or steps down, any choice he makes will now be hard to applaud. That said, Representative Jang cannot now reverse the political line aimed at hardline supporters. Therefore, I believe it will be difficult for Representative Jang to act as a variable in the future conservative political landscape." (“장 대표가 대표직에서 끝까지 버티든지 아니면 물러나든지 이제는 어떤 선택을 해도 박수받기 어렵게 됐다. 그렇다고 장 대표는 강성 지지층을 지향하는 정치적 노선을 이제 와서 돌이킬 수도 없다. 그렇기 때문에 장 대표가 향후 보수 정국의 변수로 작용하기는 어렵다고 생각한다.”)

－The PPP will elect a new floor leader on the 10th. (－국민의힘이 10일 새 원내대표를 뽑는다.)

"What's the rush to elect a floor leader just a week after the election? We haven't even properly analyzed the causes of the local election defeat. We should first calmly reflect on the election and meticulously incorporate the results into the party line. That is our duty to the party members. I find it hard to understand why our party lawmakers are offering no resistance to this flawed floor leader election schedule." (“선거 1주일 만에 뭐가 그리 급해서 원내대표부터 뽑으려 하나. 지방선거 패배에 대한 원인 분석조차 제대로 하지 못했다. 우선 선거를 차분하게 되돌아보고, 그 결과를 정당 노선에 정교하게 반영해야 한다. 그것이 당원에 대한 도리다. 우리 당 의원들이 파행적인 원내대표 선거 일정에 어째서 아무런 저항도 하지 않는지 납득하기 어렵다.”)

－What are your views on independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon's return to the party? (－무소속 한동훈 의원 복당에 대한 견해는.)

"After the election, I congratulated Lawmaker Han on his victory and told him, 'Don't rush the issue of returning to the party.' That was heartfelt advice as a political senior. Only then can the path open for Lawmaker Han and the party be renewed. Lawmaker Han also agreed, saying, 'My thoughts align exactly with that.'" (“선거 이후 한 의원에게 당선 축하 인사를 건네며 ‘복당 문제는 서두르지 말라’고 했다. 정치 선배로서 진심 어린 당부이기도 했다. 그래야 한 의원에게도 길이 열리고 당도 쇄신할 수 있다. 한 의원 역시 ‘제 생각 역시 정확히 일치한다’면서 공감했다.”)

－You trailed in the early vote count but turned the tide at 7:16 a.m. on the 4th, the day after the election. (－개표 초반 뒤지다가 선거 이튿날인 4일 오전 7시 16분 역전했다.)

"At that moment, Seoul's destiny shifted. All sorts of emotions surged in my heart. If the policy infrastructure we had built up had been uprooted entirely through a change in mayor, Seoul would have inevitably embarked on a path of decline. Now, Seoul is embarking on a leap to become a city on par with London, Tokyo, and New York. We plan to officially launch a 'Global Top 3 Committee' as soon as possible." (“그 순간 서울의 운명이 바뀌었다. 가슴 속에 온갖 소회가 휘몰아쳤다. 시장 교체로 그간 쌓아 올린 정책 인프라가 뿌리째 뽑혀 나갔다면, 서울은 쇠퇴의 길로 접어들 수밖에 없었을 것이다. 이제 서울은 런던·도쿄·뉴욕에 버금가는 도시로 거듭나기 위한 도약에 돌입한다. 빠른 시일 내로 ‘글로벌 톱3위원회’를 공식 출범시킬 예정이다.”)

－What do you see as the key factor in your victory? <<>] "Commentators talk about a 'landslide vote in the Han River belt,' but would Seoul citizens, including the 2030 generation, have voted solely based on real estate? I see it as the result of a series of policy achievements accumulating and influencing voters' choices, such as distributing 'women's safety bells' that sound alarms in crisis situations, 'Kids OK Zones' where children can be taken safely, and the 'Youth Employment Academy' that opens doors for young people's futures. Isn't that the driving force behind Oh Se-hoon's victory even under adverse conditions?" (－승리 요인은 뭐라고 보나.)

－Real estate issues can't be overlooked. You promised to begin construction on 310,000 housing units by 2031. (“평론가들은 ‘한강벨트 몰표’라고 하지만, 2030세대를 비롯한 서울시민들이 과연 부동산 하나로만 투표했겠나. 위기상황에 경보음을 울리는 ‘여성 안심벨’ 배포, 아이들을 안심하고 데리고 갈 수 있는 ‘키즈오케이존’, 청년의 미래를 열어주는 ‘청년취업사관학교’와 같은 정책 성과들이 하나둘씩 쌓여서 표심으로 작용한 결과라고 본다. 이것이 악조건 속에서도 오세훈이 승리한 원동력 아니겠나.”)

"This isn't a hastily crafted political pledge targeting the election. It's an objective 'administrative report' from responsible officials stating that if Seoul's current redevelopment projects proceed on schedule, commencing construction on 310,000 units is entirely feasible. If the central government refrains from unnecessary interference and just lets things be, it can be achieved smoothly. Specifically, I will closely manage 85 redevelopment zones—totaling 85,000 households—that need to start construction by 2028." (－부동산 문제를 빼놓을 순 없다. 2031년까지 31만호 착공을 공약했다.)

－The ballot shortage incident has sparked fierce anger among the 2030 generation. (“선거를 겨냥해서 급조한 정치 공약이 아니다. 현재 서울시 정비 사업 진도대로 나아간다면 31만호 착공이 충분히 가능하다는 담당 공무원들의 객관적인 ‘행정 보고’다. 중앙정부가 쓸데없이 간섭하지 않고 그냥 내버려만 둔다면 무난히 달성 가능하다. 구체적으로 2028년까지 착공에 들어가야 하는 85개 정비 구역, 총 8만5000가구를 밀착 관리하겠다.”)

"This is absolutely unacceptable. In a recent address to the public, I stated that 'all strong measures the public can find convincing must be mobilized to uncover the truth.' However, as the administrative head of Seoul, I cannot add anything beyond that statement." (－투표용지 부족 사태에 2030세대의 분노가 거세다.)

－There are also calls for a re-election. <<>] "I expect some politicians want a re-run of the Seoul mayoral election. I fully understand the political engineering interests, but the Public Official Election Act strictly stipulates that a full re-election cannot be held unless a flaw in the election administrative procedures constitutes a serious illegality capable of changing the outcome." (“도저히 있을 수 없는 일이다. 얼마 전 대시민 담화에서 ‘국민이 납득할 수 있는 모든 강력한 수단을 동원해 진상을 규명해야 한다’고 밝혔다. 다만 서울시 행정책임자로서 담화문 이상의 말은 보탤 수 없다.”)

－Will you run in the 2030 presidential election? <<>] "No one can guarantee whether the support formed right after this election will last until the presidential election four years from now. Starting now, I am returning to my core duty of Seoul city administration. If I were solely obsessed with power struggles like other politicians in Yeouido, would the discerning citizens of Seoul have entrusted me with city administration five times? Despite the government, the Democratic Party, investigative agencies, and some media joining forces in a 'kill Oh Se-hoon' effort, I was able to fend it off with the tangible results of meticulous administrative work. The future is unknown. I will approach my duties with the attitude of fully taking responsibility for Seoul through precise administration." (－재선거 주장도 나온다.)

item.title: "Jang Uses Ballot Shortage as a Shield" (“張, 투표지 부족을 방패막이로 쓰나”)
item.description:
Amid the aftermath of the 6.3 local elections defeat, calls for accountability against People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk continue to surface within the party. There are ongoing demands that the party can no longer be managed under Jang's reliance on hardline supporters. Jang appears to be avoiding responsibility by focusing on the recent election commission's voter rights infringement incident. (6·3 지방선거 패배를 두고 국민의힘 내에서 장동혁 대표 책임론이 계속 나오고 있다. 강성 지지층에 기댄 장 대표의 노선으로는 더는 당을 운영하기 어렵다는 요구도 계속되고 있다. 장 대표는 최근 선거관리위원회의 투표권 침해 사건에 집중하며 책임론을 회피하는 모양새다.)

Rep. Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party, who secured a fourth term by defeating Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Cho Kuk in the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, said on KBS Radio on the 8th regarding Jang: "Candidates who directly experienced this election will know, but the atmosphere on the ground was really bad." He added, "The fact that our local election report card wasn't particularly good is a common understanding among everyone." Rep. Yoo stated that Jang should clarify his position on his future. <<> People Power Party Rep. Cho Kyung-tae also said on MBC Radio the same day: "Rep. Jang clearly stated during the last party leadership election that he would step down and take responsibility if the local elections were lost." Rep. Cho added, "The ballot shortage incident should not become a shield to cover up responsibility for the election defeat. (Rep. Jang) should resign." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 민주당 김용남 후보와 조국혁신당 조국 후보 등을 제치고 4선에 성공한 국민의힘 유의동 의원은 8일 KBS 라디오에서 장 대표와 관련해 “이번 선거를 직접 뛰어본 후보들은 알겠지만 현장에서 분위기가 정말로 안 좋았다”며 “우리 지방선거의 성적표가 그렇게 썩 좋지 않았다는 부분은 모든 분의 공통 인식”이라고 했다. 유 의원은 장 대표가 거취에 대한 입장을 밝혀야 한다고 하고 있다.)

Within the People Power Party, various discussions are emerging about the results of this local election, where the party secured 4 out of 16 metropolitan government heads. The pro-Jang faction argues that compared to the 2018 local election, where the party won only 2 out of 17 metropolitan government heads, the outcome is not bad. At a press conference evaluating President Lee Jae-myung's first-anniversary press conference, Jang, when asked about his future, only replied, "Looking at objective data, how do you all evaluate this local election result?" before leaving. <<> On the other hand, there are many voices that Jang should take responsibility, given the number of close losses due to nomination disputes and failures in shifting the party's direction. A People Power Party insider said, "Aside from the local election results, I understand there are quite a few mainstream lawmakers who are skeptical about continuing under Jang's leadership." <<> Meanwhile, the People Power Party will hold its next floor leader election on the 10th. Candidates include Rep. Jeong Jeom-sik, who advocates for stabilizing the party leadership structure, and Reps. Kim Do-eup and Seong Il-jong, who have called for Jang's resignation. An opposition source commented, "The outcome of the next floor leader election will have a significant impact on the future direction of the People Power Party." (국민의힘 조경태 의원도 이날 MBC 라디오에서 “장 대표는 지난 당대표 선거 때 ‘지방선거 패배했을 경우에 물러나겠다, 책임을 지겠다’라고 분명히 이야기했다”고 했다. 조 의원은 “투표 용지 부족 사태가 선거 패배의 책임을 덮는 방패막이가 돼선 안 된다”며 “(장 대표는) 사퇴해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae, Backed by Hardcore Party Members, Faces Kim Min-seok, Supported by Lee… Showdown at August 17 Party Convention (강성당원 업은 정청래, 李 지원 받는 김민석… 8·17 전당대회 격돌)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) will hold a national convention on August 17 to elect its next party leader and five Supreme Council members. Since the next party leader will control the nomination rights for the 2028 general election, fierce competition among leadership contenders is expected. With Representative Jung Cheong-rae’s bid for re-election almost certain, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former party leader Song Young-gil have either confirmed their candidacies or are considering running. Ahead of the convention, conflicts between the pro-Jung and pro-Lee factions are escalating over issues such as accountability for the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당이 오는 8월 17일 차기 당대표와 최고위원 5명을 뽑는 전당대회를 연다. 이번 당대표는 2028년 총선 공천권을 쥐기 때문에 당권 주자 간 치열한 경쟁이 예상된다. 정청래 대표의 연임 도전이 확실시되는 가운데, 김민석 국무총리, 송영길 전 대표 등이 출마를 확정했거나 고민 중이다. 전당대회를 앞두고 6·3 지방선거 책임론 등을 둘러싸고 친청계와 친명계 간 갈등도 확산하고 있다.)

Representative Jung is expected to step down as party leader around the time the Party Convention Preparatory Committee (PCPC) is formed, likely next week, and then launch his full-fledged re-election bid. While the DPK’s party constitution and rules set no specific deadline for stepping down when seeking re-election, President Lee Jae-myung also resigned just before the formation of the PCPC when he sought re-election as party leader. However, amid rising calls for accountability over the local elections, Jung is reportedly consulting his strong support base of hardcore party members. A source close to Jung said, “Representative Jung has never publicly announced his re-election bid. He will first listen to party members and make a final decision.” (정 대표는 다음 주로 예상되는 전당대회준비위원회(전준위) 구성을 전후해 당대표직에서 사퇴한 뒤 본격적인 연임 도전에 나설 전망이다. 민주당 당헌·당규에는 연임 도전 시 사퇴 시한이 정해져 있지 않지만, 이재명 대통령도 민주당 당대표 시절 연임 도전을 위해 전준위 구성 직전 사퇴했다. 다만 정 대표는 지방선거 책임론이 불거지는 상황에서 자신의 강력한 지지 세력인 강성 당원들의 의견을 청취하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 정 대표 측 관계자는 “정 대표가 공개적으로 연임 도전을 발표한 적이 없다”며 “일단 당원 얘기를 들어보고 최종 결단을 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is expected to announce his candidacy as early as mid-to-late June, once his confirmation hearing as the next prime minister concludes. Kim is being mentioned as a pro-Lee leadership contender. Indeed, during his first anniversary press conference, President Lee Jae-myung praised Kim, saying, “With truly outstanding leadership, the Cabinet has run fiercely without any major discord. Now, it seems more appropriate for him to take on a different role, so we are making this change.” This is interpreted as the president essentially throwing his support behind Kim. A source close to Kim said, “We are also looking for Supreme Council candidates to run alongside him.” Pro-Lee lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, a former attorney for President Lee who recently lost a by-election for a Supreme Council seat, is being mentioned as a potential candidate. A DPK official commented, “The president’s appointment of a new prime minister right after the election sends the message that ‘my pick for party leader is Kim Min-seok.’ This convention will be an all-out war between the pro-Jung and anti-Jung factions.” (김민석 국무총리도 후임 총리 청문 절차가 마무리되면 이르면 6월 중하순쯤 출마 선언을 할 것으로 알려졌다. 김 총리는 친명계 당권주자로 언급되고 있다. 실제 이날 이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 김 총리에 대해 “정말로 뛰어난 리더십으로 내각이 큰 잡음 하나 없이 치열하게 잘 달려왔다”면서 “이제는 다른 역할을 맡는 게 더 적정하다고 보이기 때문에 역할을 바꾸게 된 것”이라고 했다. 대통령이 사실상 김 총리 지원에 나선 것이라는 해석이 나온다. 김 총리 측 관계자는 “함께 뛸 최고위원 후보 등도 물색 중”이라고 했다. 이재명 대통령 측 변호인 출신이자 최근 최고위원 보궐선거에서 낙선한 친명 이건태 의원 등이 최고위원 후보로 거론된다. 민주당 관계자는 “대통령이 선거 직후 후임 총리를 임명한 건 ‘내가 픽한 당대표는 김민석’이라는 메시지를 준 것”이라며 “이번 전당대회는 친청 대 반청의 한 치의 양보 없는 싸움이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Former party leader Song Young-gil, who has been rumored to be running for party leader, recently returned to the National Assembly through a by-election and is currently touring the Honam region on a three-day, two-night schedule meeting with local figures. As a result, Song did not attend a dinner meeting organized by Jung for newly elected lawmakers. A DPK official said, “Even if Song runs, he will likely strongly criticize Jung over accountability for the local elections while supporting Prime Minister Kim.” (당대표 출마설이 나오는 송영길 전 대표도 최근 보궐선거로 국회 입성에 성공한 뒤 현재 2박 3일 일정으로 호남을 돌며 지역 인사들을 만나고 있다. 이 때문에 송 전 대표는 이날 정 대표가 마련한 국회 입성 당선인들과의 만찬 회동에 불참했다. 민주당 관계자는 “송 전 대표가 출마하더라도 지방선거 책임론 등을 앞세워 정 대표를 강하게 비판하면서 김 총리를 지원할 것 같다”고 했다.)

Amid the upcoming convention, internal strife within the DPK is intensifying. Supreme Council member Lee Un-ju resigned from her post on Monday, citing leadership accountability for the election results. Lee said, “Our party relied solely on the president’s approval ratings and failed to present strategies and visions aligned with regional public sentiment.” Lee has consistently clashed with Representative Jung and represented the pro-Lee faction’s stance. South Jeolla Governor Kim Young-rok, who lost in the local election primary, said on MBC Radio, “If you listen to general public opinion in the Honam region, they say ‘Jung Cheong-rae’s era is over.’” He added, “I will launch a campaign to oppose his re-election as party leader.” On the day of the local elections, Governor Kim had said, “From this moment, I will devote everything I have to bringing down the party leader.” (전당대회를 앞두고 민주당 내분도 본격화하고 있다. 이언주 민주당 최고위원은 이날 이번 선거 결과에 대한 지도부 책임론을 제기하며 최고위원직에서 사퇴했다. 이 의원은 “우리 당은 대통령 지지도에만 의존한 나머지 지역별 민심에 부합하는 전략과 비전을 충분히 제시하지 못했다”고 말했다. 이 최고위원은 줄곧 정 대표와 각을 세우며 친명 쪽 입장을 대변해왔다. 지방선거 경선에서 탈락한 김영록 전남지사는 이날 MBC라디오에서 “(호남 지역의) 일반적인 여론을 들어보면 ‘정청래 시대는 끝났다’고 한다”면서 “당대표 연임 반대 운동을 하겠다”고 했다. 김 지사는 지방선거 당일 “이 시각부터 당대표에서 끌어내기 위해 내 모든 것을 바치겠다”고 했었다.)

The pro-Jung faction responded to those raising accountability claims against Jung by saying, “Enough is enough.” Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said, “It’s not about who should be held accountable. Especially now, isn’t there a lot of debate over the Seoul mayoral election?” In particular, addressing Governor Kim Young-rok’s vow to “bring down Representative Jung,” Cho said, “It’s regrettable that there are still attempts to groundlessly challenge the party leadership and the primary process.” Lawmaker Choi Min-hee, in a Facebook post, criticized Supreme Council member Lee Un-ju for targeting the leadership and resigning, saying, “This is not acceptable.” Supreme Council member Lee Sung-yoon, targeting former party leader Song Young-gil, who had supported independent North Jeolla Governor candidate Kim Kwan-young, asked, “Were you trying to shake the party leadership?” and added, “If you put the party first, apologize to the party members.” (친청계는 정 대표 책임론을 거론하는 세력을 향해 “이제 그만 좀 하라”고 했다. 조승래 사무총장은 “누구에게 책임 묻는 게 중요한 게 아니다. 특히 이제 서울시장 선거와 관련해 여러 갑론을박이 있지 않나”라고 했다. 특히 “정 대표를 끌어내리겠다”고 한 김영록 지사에게는 “여전히 당 경선 과정에 대해서 근거 없는 주장을 자꾸 하시면서 당 지도부와 경선 과정을 흔들어 대는 시도가 있어서 안타깝다”고 했다. 최민희 의원은 이날 페이스북 글에서 지도부를 저격하고 사퇴한 이언주 최고위원을 향해 “이러면 곤란하다”고 했다. 이성윤 최고위원은 김관영 무소속 전북지사 후보를 옹호했던 송영길 전 대표를 겨냥해 “당대표나 지도부를 흔들려고 했던 것이냐”면서 “선당후사하신다면 당원들께 사과하라”고 했다.)

As factional conflict escalated, voices of concern emerged within the party. Five-term lawmaker Park Jie-won said, “The race for party leadership is overheating, and frankly, I am gripped by great concern. A bloody convention will inevitably lead to a fight for the presidency, while people’s livelihoods, the economy, and the three major reforms to eradicate remnants of insurrection will vanish. We need to find a way to hold a quiet convention.” (계파 갈등이 본격화되자 당내에선 우려의 목소리도 나왔다. 5선의 박지원 민주당 의원은 이날 “당권 경쟁이 과열로 치닫고 있고, 솔직히 너무 큰 염려가 엄습한다”며 “피 터지는 전당대회는 불을 보듯 대권 투쟁으로 이어지고 민생, 경제, 내란 청산 3대 개혁은 실종된다. 조용한 전당대회 방법을 모색해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party 41.8%, People Power Party 41.1%… Support Rates Nearly Tied (민주당 41.8%, 국힘 41.1%… 지지율 동률 수준으로)
item.description:
In the first opinion poll following the June 3 local elections, the gap in party support between the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party narrowed to just 0.7 percentage points (p). (6.3 지방선거 이후 첫 여론조사에서 더불어민주당과 국민의힘 정당 지지율이 0.7%포인트(p) 격차로 좁혀진 것으로 나타났다.)

According to a survey conducted by Realmeter on May 4-5 at the request of Energy Economy News and released today, the Democratic Party recorded 41.8% and the People Power Party 41.1%, within the margin of error (±3.1%p). The 24.9%p gap seen in the third week of March—when the Democratic Party (53%) and People Power Party (28.1%) were at their widest this year—has shrunk to under 1%p in just 11 weeks. The decline in the ruling party’s support was largely attributed to the defection of swing voters and those in their 30s. President Yoon’s job approval rating fell 3.9%p from the previous week to 55.2%. President Yoon had previously recorded a high of 65.5% in Realmeter polls in April. (리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 지난 4~5일 조사해 이날 발표한 결과, 민주당 41.8%, 국민의힘 41.1%로 오차 범위(±3.1%p) 내 격차를 보였다. 올해 들어 가장 크게 벌어졌던 3월 3주차 민주당(53%)과 국민의힘(28.1%)의 24.9%p 격차가 11주만에 1%p 미만으로 좁혀진 것이다. 여당 지지율 하락에는 중도층과 30대 지지 이탈이 주요한 원인으로 꼽혔다. 이 대통령의 국정수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 전주보다 3.9%p 하락한 55.2%를 기록했다. 이 대통령은 리얼미터 여론조사에서 지난 4월 65.5% 최고치를 기록한 바 있다.)

The Democratic Party analyzed that the local election results, including the failure to reclaim the Seoul mayoral seat, influenced the poll. Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing today regarding the party’s support rate, “The local election outcomes, poor management, and various controversies, along with falling short of supporters’ expectations, have collectively been reflected in the party’s support rate. While it may not fully represent 100% of public opinion, it is one aspect of it. We will work harder to earn the people’s trust.” In contrast, People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon told reporters, “The ballot paper incident had a decisive impact. The party leadership, which stood guard at the scene on election night, channeled this anger effectively. The victory in the Seoul mayoral election also contributed,” he interpreted. (민주당은 서울시장 탈환 실패 등 지방선거 결과가 여론조사에 영향을 미친 것으로 분석했다. 조승래 사무총장은 이날 기자간담회에서 당 지지율과 관련해 “지방선거 결과와 부실 관리 등 여러 논란들과 지지자들의 기대에 못미친 것들이 종합적으로 정당 지지율에 반영된 것”이라며 “여론 100%를 반영한다고 볼 순 없지만 여론의 한 단면이다. 국민의 신뢰를 얻기 위해 더 노력하겠다”고 했다. 반면 국민의힘 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 “투표용지 사태가 결정적 영향을 미쳤다. 선거 개표 당일 넘어 현장을 지킨 국민의힘 지도부가 이 분노를 모아냈다”며 “서울시장 선거 승리 등도 기여했다”고 해석했다.)

Although the two parties’ support rates are closely tied, the Democratic Party maintains its stance of not yielding any of the 18 standing committee chairperson positions, including the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair, ahead of the second-half National Assembly committee formation negotiations. This would break the longstanding practice since the first parliament after democratization in 1987, where the ruling and opposition parties shared these roles. Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stated in March, “In forming the second-half committees, the principle is that the Democratic Party will be responsible for 100% of the standing committee chairperson positions.” (양당 지지율이 딱 붙었지만, 민주당은 하반기 국회 원구성 협상을 앞두고 법사위원장을 비롯한 상임위원장 18개 모두 양보하지 않겠다는 입장을 고수하고 있다. 1987년 민주화 이후 첫 국회 때부터 여야가 나눠 갖던 관행을 깨겠다는 것이다. 정청래 대표는 지난 3월 “후반기 원구성에 있어서 상임위원장은 100% 민주당이 맡아서 책임을 지겠다는 원칙”이라고 밝힌 바 있다.)

In this regard, a key Democratic Party floor official said, “If the People Power Party insists on taking the Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair and refuses to negotiate, we will have no choice but to take all standing committee chairperson positions.” The opposition argues that the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the final hurdle for all bills in standing committees, should be controlled by the opposition to prevent the ruling party’s unchecked dominance. (이와 관련해 민주당 원내 핵심 관계자는 “국민의힘이 끝까지 법사위원장을 가져가야겠다면서 협상에 임하지 않으면 어쩔 수 없이 상임위원장을 다 가져갈 수 밖에 없는 상황”이라고 했다. 야당은 모든 상임위 법안의 마지막 관문인 법사위는 야당이 가져가 여당 폭주를 막아야 한다는 입장이다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook Catches Last Train of ‘Capital Gains Tax Grace Period’, Gains 3 Billion Won (‘양도세 유예’ 막차 탄 한성숙, 30억 차익)
item.description:
It was confirmed on the 8th that Han Sung-sook, the nominee for Prime Minister, disposed of her apartment in the Asia Athletes’ Village in Jamsil-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul last month, which she had held for 20 years, yielding a profit of 2.95 billion won. Nominee Han had previously owned four residential properties, including an officetel, and sold this apartment in line with the government’s regulatory stance on multiple-home owners. The sale of the Jamsil apartment occurred just before the end of the grace period for the heavy capital gains tax on multiple-home owners. <<> According to the property register, Nominee Han sold one unit of the Jamsil Asia Athletes’ Village apartment (185㎡, with a dedicated area of 151㎡) on the 6th of last month. The transfer of ownership was completed on the 27th of last month. Since Nominee Han purchased the apartment on October 25, 2006, for 2.25 billion won, she realized a gain of 2.95 billion won from this sale. <<> Earlier, in March, during her tenure as Minister of SMEs and Startups, Nominee Han reported total assets of approximately 22.3 billion won in the public asset disclosure by the Government Ethics Committee. At that time, Nominee Han reported owning the Jamsil apartment (now sold), an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul (valued at 2.07463 billion won), a standalone house in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (valued at 1.5 billion won), and another standalone house in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi-do (valued at 630 million won). <<> In response to controversy that her ownership of multiple homes clashed with the government’s policy of regulating multiple-home owners, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups explained in February that “aside from the Samcheong-dong house, the other properties are being disposed of.” Subsequently, Nominee Han sold the Jamsil apartment at the lowest price this year. Looking at actual transaction prices for the same area (185㎡) of that apartment, most deals were in the 5.6 billion won range, with a transaction of 6 billion won in March. A source from the ruling party commented, “It appears she sought to dispose of it quickly to resolve the controversy over multiple-home ownership.” <<> However, Nominee Han is not expected to face the heavy capital gains tax on multiple-home owners for this sale of the Jamsil apartment. The date she sold the home, the 6th of last month, was just three days before the end of the grace period for the heavy capital gains tax on multiple-home owners (which lasted until the 9th of last month). Nominee Han is likely to receive the standard tax rate and long-term holding special deduction benefits. The Prime Minister’s Office Personnel Hearing Preparation Team stated, “Nominee Han will explain this during the National Assembly’s personnel hearing.” (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 20년간 보유했던 서울 송파구 잠실동 아시아선수촌아파트를 지난달 처분해 29억5000만원의 차익을 얻은 것으로 8일 확인됐다. 한 후보자는 그동안 오피스텔을 포함해 주택성 부동산을 네 채 가지고 있었는데, 정부의 다주택자 규제 기조에 따라 이 아파트를 팔았다. 한 후보자가 잠실 아파트를 판 시점은 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예를 종료하기 직전 이뤄졌다.)

item.title: “The Young People Who Raised the Ballot Issue Are Precious and Admirable… Different from Election Fraud Claims” (“투표지 문제 제기 청년들 귀하고 존경… 부정선거론과 달라”)
item.description:
Regarding the “ballot shortage crisis” in the June 3 local elections, President Lee Jae-myung stated at his first anniversary press conference, “This is an absurd incident that instantly shattered the reputation of a high-tech South Korea and a model democratic nation,” adding, “Even countries with lower levels of democratic development would find it a shocking event beyond imagination.” (6·3 지방선거 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’와 관련해 이재명 대통령은 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “첨단 대한민국, 모범적 민주 국가의 명예를 한순간에 깡그리 망가뜨린 어처구니없는 일”이라며 “민주주의 발전도가 낮은 국가들이 봐도 상상하기 어려운 충격적인 일”이라고 밝혔다.)

Specifically, on the young people who took to the streets in anger over this incident, President Lee said, “To be honest, I initially thought complacently, ‘Only a dozen or so people couldn’t vote, and it doesn’t affect the election results…’ in a somewhat careless way.” He continued, “But seeing the young people’s criticisms, I reflected that I too had a significantly diminished sensitivity to national sovereignty, or ‘sovereignty sensitivity.’” Regarding the intense criticism from the younger generation, he said, “I find it truly precious and admirable.” (특히 이번 사태에 분노해 거리로 나온 청년들에 대해 이 대통령은 “사실 저도 처음에는 ‘열몇 명이 투표를 못 했다는데 투표 결과에 영향도 없고…’라고 안일하게 생각한 측면이 없지 않았다”며 “그러나 청년들의 지적을 보며 나 역시 국민 주권에 대한 민감도, 즉 ‘주권 감수성’이 많이 떨어져 있었다는 반성이 들었다”고 했다. 또 청년층의 거센 비판을 두고선 “참으로 귀하고 존경할 만하다는 생각이 든다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, “(This issue) is somewhat mixed up with election fraud theories, but it’s different,” adding, “Using constant agitation and brainwashing to turn clearly false claims into a tool for factionalization with political motives is on a completely different level from raising the question, ‘How can it be that people are unable to vote in our South Korea?’” (이 대통령은 “(이번 사안이) 부정선거론과 좀 뒤섞여 있기는 한데 좀 다르다”며 “정치적 목적을 갖고 명백히 사실이 아닌 것을 끊임없는 선동과 세뇌를 통해 뭔가 세력화의 수단으로 삼는 것과, ‘우리 대한민국에서 어떻게 투표를 못 할 수가 있어’라는 문제 제기는 차원이 다르다”고 했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission (NEC), he said, “Reports came out that ballots were lacking from 2 PM, yet leaving it unattended without measures is so pathetic it makes you wonder ‘did they do it on purpose?’” He added, “At the very least, we need to determine whether it was intentional. Since a complaint has already been filed, we have mobilized all available administrative powers to set up a ‘Joint Investigation Headquarters’ and have ordered a swift and strong investigation to determine whether criminal charges are warranted.” (선거관리위원회에 대해서는 “낮 2시부터 투표지가 부족하다는 이야기가 나왔다는데 대책도 없이 방치한 것은 ‘일부러 그랬나’ 싶을 정도로 한심한 일”이라며 “최소한 ‘일부러 그랬는지’ 진상은 밝혀야 할 것 아니냐. 이미 고발장이 접수된 만큼, 가용한 행정 권한을 모두 동원해 ‘합동수사본부’를 꾸렸고 범죄 혐의 여부를 가리기 위해 신속하고 강력한 수사를 지시했다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, that afternoon, President Lee held a meeting with the four key figures—National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-dae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and Constitutional Court President Kim Sang-hwan—to discuss the NEC crisis. The four leaders agreed on the need for a structure where NEC heads work on a full-time basis to take responsibility for election administration. Specific reform plans are to be coordinated through parliamentary investigations and legislative processes. (한편 이날 오후 이 대통령은 조정식 국회의장, 조희대 대법원장, 김민석 국무총리, 김상환 헌법재판소장과 4부 요인 회동을 갖고 선관위 사태를 논의했다. 4부 요인은 선관위 수장들이 상시 근무하며 선거 행정을 책임지는 구조가 필요하다는 데 의견을 모았다. 세부적인 개편안은 국회 국정조사와 입법 과정을 통해 조율하기로 했다.)

However, President Lee drew a line on the possibility of constitutional amendment for adjusting the NEC’s status, which some had raised. Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Gyu-yeon said, “Given that constitutional amendment is not easy, the discussion proceeded within the framework of general legislative supplementation and institutional improvement.” (다만 일각에서 제기된 선관위 위상 조정을 위한 개헌 가능성에 대해서는 선을 그었다. 이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 “개헌이 쉽지 않은 일인 만큼, 일반적인 입법적 보완과 제도 개선 틀 안에서 논의가 진행됐다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee, Right After the Election, Says "Can't Avoid a Special Counsel"... The Ruling Party also Moves to Re-Push (李, 선거 끝나자마자 “특검 안할 수 없어”… 與도 재추진 나섰다)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, in a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th, described the results of the June 3 local elections as a "warning from the people," but regarding the Democratic Party's "fabricated indictment special counsel law," which was cited as one of the reasons for the election loss, he stated, "It can't be avoided." The special counsel law grants the special prosecutor the authority to dismiss indictments in presidential cases, and the Democratic Party had pushed for its passage in the National Assembly ahead of the election but faced opposition and put it on hold. However, after President Lee mentioned the special counsel law again on this day, the Democratic Party decided to resume its push for the law. The opposition party criticized it as a "declaration of dictatorship" and "grounds for impeachment." (이재명 대통령은 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 6·3 지방선거 결과를 “국민의 경고”라면서도, 선거 패인 중 하나로 지목된 민주당의 ‘조작기소 특검법’에 대해선 “안 할 수 없다”고 했다. 특검법은 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 권한을 특검에 부여하고 있고, 민주당이 선거 전 국회 통과를 추진하다 반발에 부딪혀 보류했다. 하지만 이 대통령이 이날 또다시 특검법을 언급하자 민주당은 특검법 재추진 방침을 정했다. 야당에선 “독재 선언” “탄핵 사유”라는 비판이 나왔다.)

During the press conference, President Lee, when asked about his assessment of the local elections, said, "I don't understand the (results)." He added, "Whether we won or lost depends on the criteria," and "If we lost something we should have won or lost where we should have won, then the problem is different. It's at least not a success." The Democratic Party won in 12 out of 16 metropolitan and provincial governor races but failed to reclaim the Seoul mayoral seat. (이 대통령은 이날 회견에서 지선 평가를 묻는 질문에 “(결과가) 이해가 안 된다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이겼냐, 졌냐는 기준에 따라 다르다”며 “이길 것을 졌다거나, 이겨야 되는 곳을 졌다고 하면 문제가 다르다. 최소한 성공은 아니다”라고 했다. 민주당은 16개 시·도지사 중 12곳에서 이겼지만 서울시장 탈환에는 실패했다.)

President Lee stated, "I should remain neutral in political elections," but "when it comes to (the election results), my expression just doesn't stay neutral." He added, "I also think I took things too easily," and "It's not like I didn't think, 'I worked so hard, I didn't do anything wrong, at least the (people) wouldn't abandon me.'" He continued, "But I think I lacked the determination to abandon that mindset and truly give my all until the very last moment, speaking earnestly and persuading with sincerity." President Lee said, "Anyway, for about two to three days (after the election results), I wasn't in a very good state." (이 대통령은 “제가 원래 정치 선거에서 중립을 해야 되지 않느냐”며 “그런데 (선거 결과에) 표정은 중립이 잘 안 되더라”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “저도 사실 너무 쉽게 생각한 측면도 있다”며 “아니 이렇게 열심히 했고, 내가 나쁜 짓 한 것도 아니고, 최소한 뭐 ‘(국민이) 버리기야 하겠어’라는 마음이 없었던 건 아니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “그러나 그 마음 다 버리고 정말 마지막 순간까지 죽을힘을 다해 온 정성을 다해 말씀드리고 설득하겠다는 마음이 부족하지 않았나 그런 생각이 들었다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “하여튼 한 2~3일은 (선거 결과 때문에) 상태가 그렇게 좋지 않았다”고 했다.)

Regarding the fabricated indictment special counsel law pushed by the Democratic Party, when asked whether the indictment in President Lee's trial would be dismissed, President Lee replied, "To give a conclusion, we just need to follow the law and common sense," and "If there's something wrong, we fix it; if not, we leave it as is." This implies that if it is proven to be a fabricated indictment, the indictment should be dismissed. The special counsel's investigation scope includes eight cases related to the president, such as the suspicions of corruption in the development of Daejang-dong and Baekhyeon-dong. (이 대통령은 민주당이 추진해온 조작기소 특검과 관련해 이 대통령 재판의 공소 취소 여부를 묻는 질문에는 “결론을 얘기하면 법과 상식대로 하면 된다”며 “잘못한 게 있으면 바로잡으면 되는 것이고, 없으면 그냥 놔두면 되는 것”이라고 했다. 조작기소로 밝혀지면 공소 취소하는 게 맞다는 것이다. 특검의 수사 대상에는 대장동, 백현동 개발 비리 의혹 등 대통령 관련 사건 8개가 포함돼 있다.)

President Lee stated regarding the prosecution's investigation, "Regardless, it does seem like there are some issues," and "Objectively, there are quite a lot of things that appear problematic." He mentioned that he could have ordered the police and prosecution to form a large-scale special investigation headquarters, saying, "That would be normal and typical." However, he added, "From the perspective of the people or the opposition party, wouldn't a neutral special counsel be better?" President Lee also said, "As for which method (between a special headquarters and a special counsel) is desirable, I think the National Assembly can decide." (이 대통령은 검찰 수사에 “어쨌든 뭔가 문제가 있어 보이기는 하지 않나”라며 “객관적으로 문제가 있어 보이는 것들이 꽤 많다”고 했다. 그러면서 검경에 대규모 특별수사본부를 구성하라고 지시할 수도 있었다면서 “그게 정상이고 일반적”이라고 했다. 하지만 “국민이나 야당 입장에서는 중립적인 특검이 하는 게 낫지 않나”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “(검경 특수본과 특검 중) 어떤 방식이 바람직할까, 국회에서 판단하면 될 것 같다”고도 했다.)

Accordingly, the Democratic Party has announced its intention to re-push the special counsel law that allows for the dismissal of indictments in the president's case as early as this month. Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae met with reporters and said, "Once the Legislation and Judiciary Committee is formed, we will likely decide on the direction for handling the special counsel law," adding, "We are keeping all options open for changes, including content and timing." A key figure in the party leadership said, "We will keep our promise to push for it after the local elections," and "Since the most wanted thing among hardline supporters is the dismissal of the indictment, all candidates in the August party leadership election will inevitably call for the dismissal." (이에 따라 민주당은 이르면 이달 중 대통령 사건의 공소 취소를 할 수 있는 특검법을 재추진하겠다는 입장이다. 조승래 사무총장은 이날 기자들과 만나 “법제사법위가 꾸려지면 특검법을 어떻게 처리할지 방향을 결정할 것 같다”며 “내용과 시기 등 (수정을) 다 열어놓고 고민 중”이라고 했다. 원내 핵심 관계자는 “지방선거 뒤 추진하겠다는 약속을 지킬 것”이라며 “강성 지지층이 가장 원하는 게 공소 취소이기 때문에 8월 당대표 선거 때도 모든 후보가 공소 취소를 외칠 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

The opposition party criticized, "President Lee has effectively declared to the entire nation his unconstitutional ambition to use his power to dismiss his own crimes." Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said, "He has stubbornly declared he will push for a special counsel to dismiss his trial," and "Now that the election is over, it's practically a declaration of dictatorship to do whatever he wants." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated, "If President Lee dismisses the indictment in his own case, I will push for impeachment." (야당은 “이 대통령이 본인의 죄를 권력을 이용해 스스로 취소하겠다는 반헌법적 야욕을 전 국민 앞에 당당하게 선포한 꼴”이라고 했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “끝끝내 재판 취소 특검을 하겠다고 선언했다”며 “선거도 끝났으니 하고 싶은 대로 다 하겠다는 사실상의 독재 선언”이라고 했다. 한동훈 무소속 의원은 “이 대통령이 자기 사건을 공소 취소하면 탄핵에 나설 것”이라고 했다.)

On the question of abolishing the prosecutor's supplementary investigation authority, President Lee said, "I plan to leave it to the National Assembly." This is interpreted as effectively accepting the demand from hardliners within the Democratic Party to "completely abolish supplementary investigation authority." The Ministry of Justice and other agencies maintain that even if the supplementary investigation authority is abolished, at least the right to request supplementary investigations should be retained. In his press conference in January, President Lee had also stated that the supplementary investigation authority was necessary in exceptional circumstances. However, on this day, President Lee said, "The distrust (of the prosecution) is too deep," and "There is a limit, and the prosecution has crossed that line far too many times. It should be considered karma." President Lee added, "In the past, the prosecution uncovered new cases, but they didn't go as far as fabricating evidence," and "This is a matter concerning the survival of the state." In response to the mention of leaving it to the National Assembly, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae said, "I am particularly grateful. We will achieve good results with a positive conclusion in the National Assembly." (이 대통령은 이날 검사의 보완수사권 폐지 여부에 대해서도 “국회에 맡길 생각”이라고 했다. 민주당 내 강경파들의 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지’ 요구를 사실상 수용했다는 해석이 나왔다. 법무부 등은 보완수사권을 폐지하더라도, 최소한 보완수사요구권은 남겨야 한다는 입장이다. 이 대통령도 지난 1월 회견에서는 예외적 상황에선 보완수사권이 필요하다고 했다. 하지만 이날 이 대통령은 “(검찰에 대한) 불신이 너무 깊다”며 “금도라는 게 있는데 검찰이 그 선을 너무 많이 넘어버렸다. 업보라고 생각해야 한다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “검찰이 과거에는 새로운 사건을 파기는 했는데 조작질까지는 하지 않았다”며 “이건 국가의 존속에 관한 문제”라고도 했다. 국회에 맡긴다는 언급에, 정청래 민주당 대표는 “특별히 감사하다. 국회에서 좋은 결론으로 성과를 내겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: “Criticism of Israel Wasn’t Just a Sudden Outburst… It’s a Matter of Human Rights and Sovereignty” (“이스라엘 비판 ‘욱’해서 한 것 아냐… 인권·주권 문제라서 지적”)
item.description:
In a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration on the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the Korean ship ‘Namu’, struck by an Iranian missile near the Strait of Hormuz last month, “It’s clear that (Iran) didn’t do it with intent,” adding, “Normally, getting hit by a missile would cause a ship to sink. But it only suffered a slight tear, so it’s a bit odd.” He noted, “However, since it is determined to be an Iranian missile, we have lodged a stern protest and demanded measures to prevent recurrence.” <<> Regarding his recent criticism of Israel for detaining Korean humanitarian workers heading to Gaza, President Lee said, “It’s not something I did out of anger,” and explained, “As the so-called head of state of the Republic of Korea, I was trying not to speak out, but then I thought, ‘This is too much, even by the standards of excess,’ so I pointed it out.” He added, “Isn’t it essentially kidnapping our citizens on the high seas where freedom of navigation is guaranteed? If it’s a matter concerning the human rights of Korean citizens or the sovereignty of the Republic of Korea, my view is that it cannot be overlooked.” <<> President Lee also said, “I will do my utmost to ensure that the valuable diplomatic and security achievements of the past year, such as the amendment of the ROK-US nuclear energy agreement, the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (SSNs), and the push for early wartime operational control transition, bear concrete fruit.” Regarding ‘self-reliant defense,’ he stated, “We have proven that the Republic of Korea is no longer a small Eastern country swayed by great powers, nor a latecomer and weakling passively following changes in the international order.” <<> President Lee revealed that he told Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi regarding the Korea-Japan Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA), for which the need for signing had been raised, that “It is currently difficult to accept this given public sentiment.” He added, “I see practical necessity,” but conveyed, “Please understand our position as well.” (이재명 대통령은 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 지난달 호르무즈 해협 인근에서 이란산 미사일에 피격된 한국 선박 ‘나무호’와 관련해 “(이란이) 의도를 가지고 한 게 아닌 건 확실하다”며 “보통 미사일에 맞으면 침몰해야 되지 않나. 살짝 터진 정도에 불과해서 좀 이상하다”고 했다. 다만 “이란산 미사일로 판단되기 때문에 엄중하게 항의하고 재발 방지 대책을 요구했다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Low Property Holding Tax, Must Bear Burden Like Advanced Countries"... July Tax Reform Announced (“보유세 낮아, 선진국만큼 부담해야”… 7월 세제 개편 예고)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th regarding criticisms that real estate policies influenced the outcomes of local elections such as the Seoul mayoral race, saying, "I think there were probably more positive effects than negative ones." This indicates his intention to maintain existing real estate policy stances, including strict loan regulations and reduced tax benefits. President Lee hinted at raising holding taxes on investment-purpose properties and also previewed real estate tax reforms after July. (이재명 대통령은 8일 부동산 정책이 서울시장 등 지방선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다는 지적에 대해 “나쁜 영향보다는 좋은 영향이 차라리 더 많지 않았을까 싶다”고 했다. 고강도 대출 규제, 세제 혜택 축소 등 기존 부동산 정책 기조를 유지하겠다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 투자 목적 부동산에 대한 보유세 인상을 시사하며 7월 이후 부동산 세제 개편도 예고했다.)

During a press conference marking his first year in office held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee said, "If I hadn't engaged in so-called verbal intervention since January to suppress (real estate prices), there would have been a massive surge." Since early this year, President Lee has shown strong resolve on real estate regulation through social media, which he claims has alleviated upward pressure on home prices. He added, "I believe I have done a decent job of curbing the upward pressure." However, analyses suggest that the victory of People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon in the Seoul mayoral election—leading not only in Gangnam but also in Yangcheon, Yeongdeungpo, Dongjak, and Gangdong districts—was driven by public anxiety and dissatisfaction with the government's real estate policies. President Lee remarked, "Across Seoul, real estate policies have always been criticized," and added, "Typically, about 20% say it's going well, and 60% say it's not, but under (the current administration), about 50% evaluated it positively." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “만약에 제가 1월 달부터 소위 말하는 구두 개입을 통해 (부동산 가격을) 좀 눌러놓지 않았으면 엄청난 폭등을 했을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 올 초부터 소셜미디어를 통해 부동산 규제에 대한 강한 의지를 드러내왔는데, 이로 인해 집값 상승 압력이 덜했다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 “저는 상승 압력을 나름 잘 막아왔다고 생각한다”고도 했다. 그러나 서울시장 선거에서 국민의힘 소속 오세훈 당선인이 강남뿐 아니라 양천·영등포·동작·강동구에서 앞서며 승리한 요인이 정부 부동산 정책에 대한 불안과 불만 때문이라는 분석이 나왔다. 이 대통령은 “서울 전역으로 따지면 부동산 정책에 대해서는 언제나 욕을 먹었다”며 “보통은 ‘잘한다’가 20%, ‘잘못한다’가 60%인데 그래도 (현 정부에서는) 50%는 잘한다는 평가를 받았다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "I plan to organize tax, financial, regulatory, and supply policies and announce them all at once soon," adding, "Tax issues will likely be possible by July." He also said, "Korea's holding tax is generally low," and explained, "While we need to protect those who own homes for residence, if it becomes a luxury item, it's appropriate to impose holding burdens similar to those in Western advanced countries." Within the ruling party, there have been calls to raise the tax base for property taxes on owners of multiple homes or ultra-high-value homes. Regarding real estate loans, President Lee noted, "No country has as many mortgage loans as Korea," and suggested, "Let's reduce credit loans or mortgage loans." On housing supply measures, he said, "Over the three years from 2022 to 2024, approvals, construction starts, and supply volumes have sharply decreased," and pledged, "Whether it's new construction, land development, or reconstruction/redevelopment, we will speed things up." <<> President Lee responded to opposition claims that real estate policies led to a jeonse (long-term rental deposit) crisis and rising jeonse prices in the capital region, acknowledging that the abolition of the deferred heavy capital gains tax for multi-homeowners reduced jeonse supply, but added, "That hasn't caused a surge in jeonse prices." He said, "The demand decreased because it was non-homeowners who bought (the multi-homeowner properties)," and argued, "The claim that jeonse prices skyrocketed due to insufficient supply is a narrative created by those who want such a situation." He further criticized the jeonse system, saying, "It distorts the market," and noted, "The large amount of jeonse loans has been a main cause of rising home prices." <<> President Lee remarked, "Real estate is peculiar—it tends to rise when so-called reform governments come to power, while under conservative governments, even when they hold rituals to boost real estate prices, they don't go up," adding, "Under (conservative administrations), they ease collateral, lower interest rates, and hold rituals to encourage taking out loans to buy homes, but prices don't rise." He continued, "They don't go up, but then it builds up over years, and when a reform government comes in, prices suddenly skyrocket," saying, "After several such experiences, it's created this odd, unrelated prejudice." <<> The press conference on that day far exceeded the initially scheduled 100 minutes, lasting about 166 minutes. President Lee wore a tie with a sky-blue striped pattern on a white background, which he also wore during last year's National Appointment Ceremony, which served as his inauguration equivalent. The presidential office stated this signified "a pledge to not forget initial intentions." Among the questioners that day, besides domestic and foreign journalists, two university student reporters from campus newspapers participated, asking about low birth rates and asset income disparity measures. President Lee personally selected which journalists to call on, and when one journalist introduced themselves as being from a Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province newspaper, he remarked, "Oh, why did I pick that one?" drawing laughter from the audience. (이 대통령은 “세제, 금융, 규제, 공급을 정리해 조만간 한꺼번에 (발표) 하려고 한다”며 “세제 문제는 7월이 돼야 가능할 것”이라고 했다. 또 “우리나라의 보유세가 대체로 낮다”며 “거주 용도로 주택을 가지고 있는 건 보호해야 하지만, 그게 사치품이 돼 있다면 서구 선진국이 하는 것만큼의 보유 부담을 갖게 하는 것이 맞겠다”고 했다. 여권에서는 다주택자나 초고가 주택 보유자 재산세 산정 때 과세표준을 올리자는 주장이 나왔었다. 부동산 대출에 대해서도 이 대통령은 “대한민국처럼 부동산 담보 대출이 많은 나라는 없다”며 “신용대출 또는 담보대출을 좀 줄이자”고 했다. 주택 공급 대책과 관련해선 “2022~2024년 3년 동안 인가와 착공과 공급량이 확 줄었다”며 “신축이든, 택지 개발이든, 재건축·재개발이든 속도를 내서 빨리 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Paying Off Debt with Semiconductor Tax Surplus Is Foolish... Invest to Restore Growth Rate" (“반도체 초과세수로 빚 갚는 건 바보짓… 성장률 회복 위해 투자”)
item.description:
At a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung addressed the utilization of the massive tax surplus generated by the semiconductor boom, stating, "Treating it as general tax revenue for fiscal spending in the usual way is a foolish act that abandons the role of fiscal policy, and using it to pay off national debt is also foolish." He added, "We should make long-term investments to restore the potential growth rate, including in semiconductors." (이재명 대통령은 8일 취임 1주년 기자 간담회에서 반도체 호황으로 발생하는 대규모 초과 세수의 활용 방안에 대해 “일반 세수로 취급해 재정을 지출하는 통상적 방법은 재정의 역할을 포기한 바보 같은 짓이고, 국가 부채를 갚자는 것도 바보 같은 짓”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “반도체 등 잠재 성장률 회복을 위한 장기 투자를 해야 한다”고 했다.)

During the press conference, questions about high exchange rates and high inflation were also raised, to which President Lee responded, "It's a temporary phenomenon" and "under stable management." (이날 간담회에서는 고환율·고물가 상황에 대한 질문도 나왔는데 이 대통령은 “일시적인 현상” “안정적 관리 (상황)”이라고 답했다.)

In response to a question about the most effective way to use the tax surplus from the semiconductor boom, President Lee said, "We are focusing on making large-scale investments in areas where the private sector cannot, such as discovering new growth engines like semiconductors, and making long-term investments to restore the potential growth rate to give hope to the younger generation." (이 대통령은 이날 ‘반도체 호황으로 인한 초과 세수를 가장 효과적으로 사용할 수 있는 방안이 무엇이냐’는 질문에 “반도체 같은 새 성장 동력을 발굴하는 등 민간이 할 수 없는 영역에 대대적 투자를 하고, 청년 세대들에게 희망을 줄 수 있도록 잠재성장률 회복에 장기 투자하는 방향으로 중심을 잡고 있다”고 답했다.)

President Lee questioned the plan to repay national debt with the semiconductor tax surplus, stating that South Korea faces a crisis of a "falling potential growth rate." He said, "Our country's potential growth rate is dropping by 1% every five years. That's what the statistics show." He continued, "Raising the potential growth rate is a truly important task. Does paying off debt increase this number? No, it doesn't." He added, "The value of 1 trillion won today and the value of 1 trillion won ten years from now are incomparable. The basic principle of policy is to spend now if the current value is high, and spend later if the future value is high." (이 대통령은 대한민국이 ‘잠재 성장률 추락’ 위기에 처해 있다면서 반도체 초과 세수로 국가 채무를 상환하는 방안에 의문을 제기했다. 이 대통령은 “5년마다 국가의 잠재 성장률이 1%씩 떨어지고 있다. 통계가 그렇다”며 “잠재 성장률을 높이는 게 정말 중요한 과제인데, 빚을 갚는다고 해서 이 숫자가 올라가느냐. 그건 아니다”라고 했다. 이어 “현재 1조원의 가치와 10년 후 1조원의 가치는 비교할 수 없다”며 “현재 가치가 높다면 지금 써야 하고, 미래 가치가 높다면 나중에 써야 하는 것이 정책의 기본”이라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "We will undertake large-scale investments in areas where the private sector is hesitant but that are essential for the nation," and added, "Even if we don't see immediate returns, I will commit to long-term investment with the mindset of planting high-value-added 'fruit trees' and cultivating a forest so that descendants 30, 50, or 100 years from now can benefit." (이 대통령은 “민간이 선뜻 나설 수 없지만 국가적으로 꼭 해야 하는 영역에 대대적인 투자를 감행할 것”이라며 “당대에는 수확이 안 되더라도 30년, 50년, 100년 뒤 후손들이 쓸 수 있도록 고부가가치 ‘과수나무’를 심고 숲을 가꾼다는 마음으로 장기 투자에 임하겠다”고 했다.)

The presidential office estimates that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will pay around 125 trillion won in corporate tax next year. This is an increase of at least 100 trillion won compared to last year. The plan is to primarily direct this money toward investment. (청와대는 내년 삼성전자와 하이닉스가 내는 법인세를 125조 정도로 예측하고 있다. 이는 작년과 비교해 최소 100조 이상 증가한 것이다. 이 돈을 주로 투자로 돌리겠다는 것이다.)

Regarding arguments for discussing social redistribution plans for the excess profits from semiconductors, President Lee said, "Discussion is possible, but the debate itself must be cautious. If handled poorly, we could end up trampling on growing sprouts." (이 대통령은 반도체 초과 이윤에 대한 사회적 재분배 방안을 논의해야 한다는 주장에 대해선 “논의는 할 수 있겠지만 논쟁 자체는 신중해야 한다”며 “자칫 잘못하면 자라나는 새싹을 밟는 상황이 발생할 수 있다”고 했다.)

On high inflation caused by the Middle East war, President Lee said, "Currently, the overall inflation rate is being managed relatively stably compared to other countries," adding, "We will mobilize all available national capabilities to minimize the rate of increase, and we will not reach a crisis situation." (한편, 이 대통령은 중동 전쟁으로 인한 고물가에 대해 “지금 현재도 전체 물가 상승률은 다른 나라에 비해서 나름 안정적으로 관리되고 있다”며 “국가가 가진 역량을 최대한 동원해서 상승 폭이 최소화될 수 있도록 할 생각으로, 위기 상황까지는 가지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "By continuing to normalize market order and manage unnecessary and excessive price increases, we can sufficiently avoid the worst-case scenario," and added, "We are striving to minimize inflationary pressure through measures such as implementing a maximum price system (for petroleum products), utilizing strategic reserves, and supporting cost compensation for import source diversification." (이 대통령은 “앞으로도 시장 질서를 정상화해 불필요하고 과도한 물가 상승을 관리하면 최악의 사태는 충분히 피할 수 있을 것”이라며 “(석유 제품) 최고 가격제 시행이나 비축유 활용, 수입선 다변화에 따른 비용 보전 지원 등을 통해 물가 상승 압력을 최소화하려고 노력하고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the recent spike in the exchange rate, President Lee said, "It's true that the mid-1500 won level is high. The current exchange rate appears to be abnormal," but added, "I see it as a temporary phenomenon." Citing factors driving the exchange rate up, such as the Middle East war and stock market conditions, he said, "It's difficult for this to continue. While there may not be a target exchange rate, there likely is an estimated appropriate rate." At a New Year's press conference in January, President Lee had commented on the rising exchange rate, saying, "It's difficult to restore it to normal solely through South Korea's policies," and adding, "Foreign exchange authorities predict that the exchange rate will soon come down to the 1,400 won level." (이 대통령은 최근 치솟는 환율에 대해서도 “1500원대 중반대는 높은 건 사실이다. 지금 환율은 정상은 아닌 것으로 보인다”면서도 “일시적인 현상으로 본다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 중동 전쟁, 증시 상황 등 환율 상승 요인을 거론하면서 “이게 계속되기는 어렵다. 목표 환율이라는 게 있기는 어렵지만 짐작되는 적정 환율은 있을 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 지난 1월 신년 기자회견에서는 환율 상승에 대해 “대한민국만의 정책으로 원상회복은 어려운 상황”이라며 “외환당국은 환율이 조만간 1400원선으로 내려온다고 예측한다”고 했었다.)

item.title: As Local Elections Approach, Number of NEC Employees on Leave Rises by 22% (지방선거 앞두고, 선관위 휴직자 수 22% 늘어)
item.description:
A phenomenon in which the number of National Election Commission (NEC) employees taking leave increases ahead of national elections and then decreases after the elections have been found to have repeated for at least 10 years since 2016. During this period, there were nine national elections, and the trend of rising leave-takers just before elections was common across all except the 2017 presidential election. While NEC employees have the legal right to take leave, the recurring increase in leave-takers around election times has drawn criticism from political circles, pointing to problems within the NEC's organizational culture. <<> According to data submitted by the National Election Commission on the 8th to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Seung-soo, the number of NEC employees on leave stood at 181 as of the end of May, one month before the June 3 local elections. This accounts for 6% of the NEC's total authorized staff (3,034). The number of leave-takers, which was 148 at the end of December last year, increased to 164 in January and has been on a consistent upward trend since. <<> Following criticism that employees rush to take leave during national elections, the National Election Commission reportedly notified its staff ahead of the local elections, asking them to "refrain from unnecessary leave before the elections." However, the increase in leave-takers repeated itself. Amid this, the June 3 local elections saw an unprecedented incident where voting papers ran out at 91 polling stations nationwide. <<> Lawmaker Kim Seung-soo stated, "The complacent organizational culture of the NEC has led to a major disaster that even deprives voters of their right to vote," and added, "Reforms on the level of disbanding the NEC are necessary." <<> ◇In 2023, a Year Without National Elections, NEC Leave-Takers Decreased <<> The phenomenon of the number of NEC employees on leave increasing ahead of elections has shown a similar trend each time. In 2022, when both the presidential and local elections were held consecutively, the number of leave-takers exceeded 200 for four months from March (presidential election) to June (local elections). The March presidential election that year saw the infamous "basket ballot" incident, considered one of the worst cases of election mismanagement. <<> In June 2022, when the local elections were held, leave-takers numbered 226, accounting for 7.6% of the NEC's then-authorized staff (2,961). The number of leave-takers began to decline after the elections. In July 2022, immediately after the local elections, the number fell to 195, and by the end of December that year, it had decreased to 161. <<> This trend contrasts with 2023, a year without any national elections. The number of leave-takers dropped to 155 in January 2023 and remained in the 130-150 range through the end of the year. <<> In the second half of 2023, a recruitment scandal involving former high-ranking NEC officials interfering in the hiring of their children brought the NEC's lax organizational culture under public scrutiny. During this process, the practice of employees taking leave ahead of national elections was also criticized. At the time, then-Chairman of the National Election Commission, Noh Tae-ak, rejected calls for his resignation, stating, "Reforming the NEC is the priority." <<> However, the pattern of leave-takers increasing ahead of the 2024 National Assembly elections and then decreasing again after the elections repeated itself. The number of leave-takers rose starting in April 2025, when the presidential election was confirmed due to the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol, and then decreased again after the election. Over the past 10 years, parental leave has been the most common reason for NEC employees taking leave. <<> According to statistics on national public officials from the Ministry of Personnel Management, as of the end of 2024, 7.4% of national public officials were on leave. According to the Ministry of the Interior and Safety's statistics on local government officials, as of the end of 2025, the leave rate was 10.9%. In contrast, the recent leave rate for NEC employees has been relatively low, at around 5-6%. <<> However, given the nature of the NEC, where work intensifies during national elections, criticism from political circles highlights that a concentration of leave-takers at a specific time just before elections is problematic. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon stated, "I will propose a bill to restrict the indiscriminate use of vacation and leave by NEC employees during national election periods." (전국 단위 선거 때마다 선거관리위원회 직원 가운데 휴직자가 늘어났다가 선거가 끝나면 감소하는 현상이 2016년 이후 최소 10년간 반복된 것으로 나타났다. 이 기간엔 총 9차례 전국 선거가 있었는데, 선거 직전 휴직자가 증가하는 추세는 2017년 대선만 제외하고 공통적으로 나타났다. 선관위 직원도 법적으로 보장된 휴직을 할 권리가 있지만, 선거 때마다 휴직자가 반복적으로 증가하는 것은 선관위 조직 문화에 문제가 있다는 지적이 정치권에서 나온다.)

item.title: "Warning from the People… Governance Direction Remains Unchanged" (“지선, 국민의 경고… 국정기조는 유지”)
item.description:
During a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung commented on the results of the June 3rd local elections, stating, "Although an incomprehensible situation unfolded, it is a warning from the people to me or to this administration." While the Democratic Party of Korea won in 12 out of 16 metropolitan and provincial governorships, its defeats in four areas, including Seoul, were interpreted as an acknowledgment that the outcome should be taken seriously. (이재명 대통령은 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 “도대체 납득할 수 없는 상황이 벌어지기는 했지만, 국민이 저에게 또는 이 정권에 주는 경고”라고 말했다. 더불어민주당이 16개 시·도지사 중 12곳에서 이겼지만 서울을 포함한 4곳에서 패한 것에 대해 무겁게 받아들인다는 의미로 해석됐다.)

President Lee remarked, "In golf and elections, if you lift your head, you lose," adding, "(Seoul voters) chose Democratic Party candidates for district office or city council but voted differently for mayor—isn’t that frightening?" (이 대통령은 “골프와 선거는 고개 들면 진다”며 “(서울 유권자가) 구청장 또는 시의원은 민주당 찍으면서 시장은 굳이 다른 데를 찍는 이런 선택, 무섭지 않나”라고도 했다.)

Regarding the "ballot paper shortage incident at the election commission" during the electoral process, which has fueled voter anger, particularly among those in their 20s and 30s, President Lee expressed regret, saying, "It shattered everything about the exemplary democratic nation of South Korea in an instant. I deeply reflect on this. We were far too complacent." (이 대통령은 선거 과정에서 벌어진 ‘선관위 투표용지 부족 사태’에 대해 2030세대를 중심으로 유권자 분노가 확산하는 현 상황에 대해 “모범적 민주국가 대한민국의 모든 걸 한순간에 깡그리 망가뜨린 것”이라며 “많이 반성한다. 너무 안일했다”고 유감을 표했다.)

However, President Lee stated, "The direction of state affairs will not change." On the "fabricated indictment special counsel" investigation—criticized as an effort by the Democratic Party to erase President Lee’s criminal cases—he said, "It’s unavoidable. If something has been concealed, it must be brought to light." While he could establish a large-scale special investigation headquarters under the prosecution and police under his direct command, he noted, "From the perspective of the people or the opposition, a neutral special counsel might be better." Regarding the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers, he indicated, "I plan to leave it to the National Assembly," effectively leaning toward abolition.
